function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;

j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}

function parseRemoveCommand() {

}

function doaction() {
if (comA==0) {
this.mode = MODE_HIDE;

} else if (comA==1) {

} else {

this.saytime = 2;
}
} else if (comA==2) {
this.mode = MODE_WALK;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
} else if (comA==3) { // look
dx = ex-x;
dy = ey-y;
dir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx>0? 3 : 1) : (dy>0? 2 : 0));
} else if (comA==4) { // say
message #s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
} else if (comA==5) {
if (edir==0) { sy = -1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==1) { sx = -1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (edir==2) { sy = 1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==3) { sx = 1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (sx>=0.05 || sy>=0.05) {
veclen = (sx^2+sy^2)^0.5;
this.slidex = sx*2/veclen;
this.slidey = sy*2/veclen;
this.slidesubx = abs(this.slidex/15);
this.slidesuby = abs(this.slidey/15);

this.mode = MODE_SLIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
}
} else if (comA==6) {

setstring this.emoticon,#s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
doani();
}
} else if (comA==7) {

setstring this.playgani,#s(this.comP);
this.mode = MODE_PLAY;

this.actiontime = 10;
}
} else if (comA==8) {
setstring this.followperson,#s(this.ePlayer);
setarray this.followpos,0;
this.mode = MODE_FOLLOW;
this.actiontime = -1;
dofollowing();
}

function dowalking() {
canwarp2;
doani();

testx = x + (dir==1? -0.5 : dir==3? 0.5 : 0);
testy = y + (dir==0? -0.5 : dir==2? 0.5 : 0);
checkonwall();
if (isonwall==false) {
x = testx;
y = testy;
} else
dir = (dir+2)%4; // turning

this.walkstep++;
if (this.walkstep>=3) {
this.walkstep = 0;
if (random(0,1)<0.5)
dir = int(random(0,4));
}
}
function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}

}

setstring this.gani,bomy_attack;
else if (this.mode==MODE_PLAY)

setstring this.gani,#s(this.gani)_e,#s(this.emoticon);
setcharani #s(this.gani),;
}

// --- Functions ---

function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;
this.commandsE[i] = comE;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}
function parseAddCommand() {
if (arraylen(this.commandsE)>=this.maxcommands)
message -max #v(this.maxcommands) commands-;
else {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else if (comA==4 && strlen(#s(this.comP))>50)
message -max 50 character for the say action-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0)
removeCommand();
addCommand();
message -command added-;
}
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}
function parseRemoveCommand() {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0) {
removeCommand();
message -command removed-;
} else
message -command not found-;
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}

function checkplayernear() {
foundplayer = 0;
for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++) if (players[i].id>0) {
if (abs(players[i].x-x)<10 && abs(players[i].y-y)<10) {
if (indexof(+#a(i)+,#s(this.owners))>=0)
foundplayer = 2;
else if (foundplayer>0)
continue;
else
foundplayer = 1;
ex = players[i].x;
ey = players[i].y;
edir = players[i].dir;
setstring this.ePlayer,#a;
}
}
if (this.playernear!=1 && foundplayer==1) {
comE = 0;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
if (this.playernear!=2 && foundplayer==2) {
comE = 3;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
this.playernear = foundplayer;
}
function checkactionend() {
if (this.actiontime>0) {
if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
hitobjects 0.5,x+1.5+dirgo[dir*2],y+2+dirgo[dir*2+1];

this.actiontime -= this.lasttimeout;
if (this.actiontime<=0)
donormal();
}
}
function checksayend() {
if (this.saytime>0) {
this.saytime -= this.lasttimeout;
if (this.saytime<=0) {
message;
if (strlen(#s(this.emoticon))>0) {
setstring this.emoticon,;
doani();
}
}
}
}
function doevent() {
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;

comA = this.commandsA[j];
if (this.commandsP[j]>=0)
setstring this.comP,#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsP[j]));
else
setstring this.comP,;
doaction();
}
}
function doaction() {
if (comA==0) {
this.mode = MODE_HIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = 5;
} else if (comA==1) {
if (this.food>=20) {
if (this.mode!=MODE_ATTACK)
this.food--;
this.mode = MODE_ATTACK;
doani();
this.actiontime = 2;
} else {
message -no food-;
this.saytime = 2;
}
} else if (comA==2) {
this.mode = MODE_WALK;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
} else if (comA==3) { // look
dx = ex-x;
dy = ey-y;
dir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx>0? 3 : 1) : (dy>0? 2 : 0));
} else if (comA==4) { // say
message #s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
} else if (comA==5) {
if (edir==0) { sy = -1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==1) { sx = -1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (edir==2) { sy = 1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==3) { sx = 1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (sx>=0.05 || sy>=0.05) {
veclen = (sx^2+sy^2)^0.5;
this.slidex = sx*2/veclen;
this.slidey = sy*2/veclen;
this.slidesubx = abs(this.slidex/15);
this.slidesuby = abs(this.slidey/15);

this.mode = MODE_SLIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
}
} else if (comA==6) {
if (!strequals(#s(this.emoticon),#s(this.comP))) {
setstring this.emoticon,#s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
doani();
}
} else if (comA==7) {
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
setstring this.playgani,#s(this.comP);
this.mode = MODE_PLAY;
doani();
this.actiontime = 10;
}
} else if (comA==8) {
setstring this.followperson,#s(this.ePlayer);
setarray this.followpos,0;
this.mode = MODE_FOLLOW;
this.actiontime = -1;
dofollowing();
}
}
function dowalking() {
canwarp2;
doani();

testx = x + (dir==1? -0.5 : dir==3? 0.5 : 0);
testy = y + (dir==0? -0.5 : dir==2? 0.5 : 0);
checkonwall();
if (isonwall==false) {
x = testx;
y = testy;
} else
dir = (dir+2)%4; // turning

this.walkstep++;
if (this.walkstep>=3) {
this.walkstep = 0;
if (random(0,1)<0.5)
dir = int(random(0,4));
}
}
function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}
function donormal() {
this.playernear = 0;
comA = 2;
doaction();
}

setstring this.gani,bomy_kick;
else if (this.mode==MODE_HIDE)
setstring this.gani,bomy_hide;
else if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
setstring this.gani,bomy_attack;
else if (this.mode==MODE_PLAY)
setstring this.gani,bomy_#s(this.playgani);
if (strlen(#s(this.emoticon))>0 && this.mode in {0,1,3,4})
setstring this.gani,#s(this.gani)_e,#s(this.emoticon);
setcharani #s(this.gani),;
}

// --- Functions ---

function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;
this.commandsE[i] = comE;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}
function parseAddCommand() {
if (arraylen(this.commandsE)>=this.maxcommands)
message -max #v(this.maxcommands) commands-;
else {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else if (comA==4 && strlen(#s(this.comP))>50)
message -max 50 character for the say action-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0)
removeCommand();
addCommand();
message -command added-;
}
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}
function parseRemoveCommand() {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0) {
removeCommand();
message -command removed-;
} else
message -command not found-;
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}

function checkplayernear() {
foundplayer = 0;
for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++) if (players[i].id>0) {
if (abs(players[i].x-x)<10 && abs(players[i].y-y)<10) {
if (indexof(+#a(i)+,#s(this.owners))>=0)
foundplayer = 2;
else if (foundplayer>0)
continue;
else
foundplayer = 1;
ex = players[i].x;
ey = players[i].y;
edir = players[i].dir;
setstring this.ePlayer,#a;
}
}
if (this.playernear!=1 && foundplayer==1) {
comE = 0;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
if (this.playernear!=2 && foundplayer==2) {
comE = 3;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
this.playernear = foundplayer;
}
function checkactionend() {

if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
hitobjects 0.5,x+1.5+dirgo[dir*2],y+2+dirgo[dir*2+1];

this.actiontime -= this.lasttimeout;
if (this.actiontime<=0)
donormal();
}
}
function checksayend() {

this.saytime -= this.lasttimeout;

message;

setstring this.emoticon,;
doani();
}
}
}
}
function doevent() {
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;

comA = this.commandsA[j];
if (this.commandsP[j]>=0)
setstring this.comP,#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsP[j]));
else
setstring this.comP,;
doaction();
}
}
function doaction() {
if (comA==0) {
this.mode = MODE_HIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = 5;
} else if (comA==1) {
if (this.food>=20) {
if (this.mode!=MODE_ATTACK)
this.food--;
this.mode = MODE_ATTACK;
doani();
this.actiontime = 2;
} else {
message -no food-;
this.saytime = 2;
}
} else if (comA==2) {
this.mode = MODE_WALK;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
} else if (comA==3) { // look
dx = ex-x;
dy = ey-y;
dir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx>0? 3 : 1) : (dy>0? 2 : 0));
} else if (comA==4) { // say
message #s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
} else if (comA==5) {
if (edir==0) { sy = -1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==1) { sx = -1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (edir==2) { sy = 1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==3) { sx = 1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (sx>=0.05 || sy>=0.05) {
veclen = (sx^2+sy^2)^0.5;
this.slidex = sx*2/veclen;
this.slidey = sy*2/veclen;
this.slidesubx = abs(this.slidex/15);
this.slidesuby = abs(this.slidey/15);

this.mode = MODE_SLIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
}
} else if (comA==6) {
if (!strequals(#s(this.emoticon),#s(this.comP))) {
setstring this.emoticon,#s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
doani();
}
} else if (comA==7) {
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
setstring this.playgani,#s(this.comP);
this.mode = MODE_PLAY;
doani();
this.actiontime = 10;
}
} else if (comA==8) {
setstring this.followperson,#s(this.ePlayer);
setarray this.followpos,0;
this.mode = MODE_FOLLOW;
this.actiontime = -1;
dofollowing();
}
}
function dowalking() {
canwarp2;
doani();

testx = x + (dir==1? -0.5 : dir==3? 0.5 : 0);
testy = y + (dir==0? -0.5 : dir==2? 0.5 : 0);
checkonwall();
if (isonwall==false) {
x = testx;
y = testy;
} else
dir = (dir+2)%4; // turning

this.walkstep++;
if (this.walkstep>=3) {
this.walkstep = 0;
if (random(0,1)<0.5)
dir = int(random(0,4));
}
}
function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}

this.playernear = 0;
comA = 2;

}

setcharani #s(this.gani),;
}

function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;
this.commandsE[i] = comE;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}
function parseAddCommand() {
if (arraylen(this.commandsE)>=this.maxcommands)
message -max #v(this.maxcommands) commands-;
else {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else if (comA==4 && strlen(#s(this.comP))>50)
message -max 50 character for the say action-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0)
removeCommand();
addCommand();
message -command added-;
}
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}
function parseRemoveCommand() {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0) {
removeCommand();
message -command removed-;
} else
message -command not found-;
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}

function checkplayernear() {
foundplayer = 0;
for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++) if (players[i].id>0) {
if (abs(players[i].x-x)<10 && abs(players[i].y-y)<10) {
if (indexof(+#a(i)+,#s(this.owners))>=0)
foundplayer = 2;
else if (foundplayer>0)
continue;
else
foundplayer = 1;
ex = players[i].x;
ey = players[i].y;
edir = players[i].dir;
setstring this.ePlayer,#a;
}
}
if (this.playernear!=1 && foundplayer==1) {
comE = 0;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
if (this.playernear!=2 && foundplayer==2) {
comE = 3;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
this.playernear = foundplayer;
}
function checkactionend() {
if (this.actiontime>0) {
if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
hitobjects 0.5,x+1.5+dirgo[dir*2],y+2+dirgo[dir*2+1];

this.actiontime -= this.lasttimeout;
if (this.actiontime<=0)
donormal();
}
}
function checksayend() {
if (this.saytime>0) {
this.saytime -= this.lasttimeout;
if (this.saytime<=0) {
message;
if (strlen(#s(this.emoticon))>0) {
setstring this.emoticon,;
doani();
}
}
}
}
function doevent() {
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;

comA = this.commandsA[j];
if (this.commandsP[j]>=0)
setstring this.comP,#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsP[j]));
else
setstring this.comP,;
doaction();
}
}
function doaction() {
if (comA==0) {
this.mode = MODE_HIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = 5;
} else if (comA==1) {
if (this.food>=20) {
if (this.mode!=MODE_ATTACK)
this.food--;
this.mode = MODE_ATTACK;
doani();
this.actiontime = 2;
} else {
message -no food-;
this.saytime = 2;
}
} else if (comA==2) {
this.mode = MODE_WALK;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
} else if (comA==3) { // look
dx = ex-x;
dy = ey-y;
dir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx>0? 3 : 1) : (dy>0? 2 : 0));
} else if (comA==4) { // say
message #s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
} else if (comA==5) {
if (edir==0) { sy = -1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==1) { sx = -1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (edir==2) { sy = 1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==3) { sx = 1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (sx>=0.05 || sy>=0.05) {
veclen = (sx^2+sy^2)^0.5;
this.slidex = sx*2/veclen;
this.slidey = sy*2/veclen;
this.slidesubx = abs(this.slidex/15);
this.slidesuby = abs(this.slidey/15);

this.mode = MODE_SLIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
}
} else if (comA==6) {
if (!strequals(#s(this.emoticon),#s(this.comP))) {
setstring this.emoticon,#s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
doani();
}
} else if (comA==7) {
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
setstring this.playgani,#s(this.comP);
this.mode = MODE_PLAY;
doani();
this.actiontime = 10;
}
} else if (comA==8) {
setstring this.followperson,#s(this.ePlayer);
setarray this.followpos,0;
this.mode = MODE_FOLLOW;
this.actiontime = -1;
dofollowing();
}
}
function dowalking() {
canwarp2;
doani();

testx = x + (dir==1? -0.5 : dir==3? 0.5 : 0);
testy = y + (dir==0? -0.5 : dir==2? 0.5 : 0);
checkonwall();
if (isonwall==false) {
x = testx;
y = testy;
} else
dir = (dir+2)%4; // turning

this.walkstep++;
if (this.walkstep>=3) {
this.walkstep = 0;
if (random(0,1)<0.5)
dir = int(random(0,4));
}
}
function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}
function donormal() {
this.playernear = 0;
comA = 2;
doaction();
}

else if (this.mode==MODE_HIDE)
setstring this.gani,bomy_hide;
else if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
setstring this.gani,bomy_attack;

setcharani #s(this.gani),;
}

// --- Functions ---

function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;
this.commandsE[i] = comE;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}
function parseAddCommand() {
if (arraylen(this.commandsE)>=this.maxcommands)
message -max #v(this.maxcommands) commands-;
else {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)

else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0)
removeCommand();

message -command added-;
}
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}

function checkplayernear() {
foundplayer = 0;
for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++) if (players[i].id>0) {
if (abs(players[i].x-x)<10 && abs(players[i].y-y)<10) {
if (indexof(+#a(i)+,#s(this.owners))>=0)
foundplayer = 2;
else if (foundplayer>0)
continue;
else
foundplayer = 1;
ex = players[i].x;
ey = players[i].y;
edir = players[i].dir;
setstring this.ePlayer,#a;
}
}
if (this.playernear!=1 && foundplayer==1) {
comE = 0;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
if (this.playernear!=2 && foundplayer==2) {
comE = 3;
setstring this.comC,;
doevent();
}
this.playernear = foundplayer;
}

}

function doevent() {
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;

comA = this.commandsA[j];
if (this.commandsP[j]>=0)
setstring this.comP,#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsP[j]));
else
setstring this.comP,;
doaction();
}
}
function doaction() {
if (comA==0) {
this.mode = MODE_HIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = 5;
} else if (comA==1) {
if (this.food>=20) {
if (this.mode!=MODE_ATTACK)
this.food--;
this.mode = MODE_ATTACK;
doani();
this.actiontime = 2;
} else {
message -no food-;
this.saytime = 2;
}
} else if (comA==2) {
this.mode = MODE_WALK;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
} else if (comA==3) { // look
dx = ex-x;
dy = ey-y;
dir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx>0? 3 : 1) : (dy>0? 2 : 0));
} else if (comA==4) { // say
message #s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
} else if (comA==5) {
if (edir==0) { sy = -1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==1) { sx = -1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (edir==2) { sy = 1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==3) { sx = 1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (sx>=0.05 || sy>=0.05) {
veclen = (sx^2+sy^2)^0.5;
this.slidex = sx*2/veclen;
this.slidey = sy*2/veclen;
this.slidesubx = abs(this.slidex/15);
this.slidesuby = abs(this.slidey/15);

this.mode = MODE_SLIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
}
} else if (comA==6) {
if (!strequals(#s(this.emoticon),#s(this.comP))) {
setstring this.emoticon,#s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
doani();
}
} else if (comA==7) {
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
setstring this.playgani,#s(this.comP);
this.mode = MODE_PLAY;
doani();
this.actiontime = 10;
}
} else if (comA==8) {
setstring this.followperson,#s(this.ePlayer);
setarray this.followpos,0;
this.mode = MODE_FOLLOW;
this.actiontime = -1;
dofollowing();
}
}
function dowalking() {
canwarp2;
doani();

testx = x + (dir==1? -0.5 : dir==3? 0.5 : 0);
testy = y + (dir==0? -0.5 : dir==2? 0.5 : 0);
checkonwall();
if (isonwall==false) {
x = testx;
y = testy;
} else
dir = (dir+2)%4; // turning

this.walkstep++;
if (this.walkstep>=3) {
this.walkstep = 0;
if (random(0,1)<0.5)
dir = int(random(0,4));
}
}
function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}
function donormal() {
this.playernear = 0;
comA = 2;
doaction();
}

else if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
setstring this.gani,bomy_attack;

setcharani #s(this.gani),;
}

// --- Functions ---

function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;
this.commandsE[i] = comE;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}
function parseAddCommand() {
if (arraylen(this.commandsE)>=this.maxcommands)
message -max #v(this.maxcommands) commands-;
else {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else if (comA==4 && strlen(#s(this.comP))>50)
message -max 50 character for the say action-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0)
removeCommand();
addCommand();
message -command added-;
}
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}
function parseRemoveCommand() {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0) {
removeCommand();
message -command removed-;
} else
message -command not found-;
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}

this.saytime = 2;
}
} else if (comA==2) {
this.mode = MODE_WALK;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
} else if (comA==3) { // look
dx = ex-x;
dy = ey-y;
dir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx>0? 3 : 1) : (dy>0? 2 : 0));
} else if (comA==4) { // say
message #s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
} else if (comA==5) {
if (edir==0) { sy = -1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==1) { sx = -1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (edir==2) { sy = 1; sx = (x-ex-0.5); }
if (edir==3) { sx = 1; sy = (y-ey); }
if (sx>=0.05 || sy>=0.05) {
veclen = (sx^2+sy^2)^0.5;
this.slidex = sx*2/veclen;
this.slidey = sy*2/veclen;
this.slidesubx = abs(this.slidex/15);
this.slidesuby = abs(this.slidey/15);

this.mode = MODE_SLIDE;
doani();
this.actiontime = -1;
}
} else if (comA==6) {
if (!strequals(#s(this.emoticon),#s(this.comP))) {
setstring this.emoticon,#s(this.comP);
this.saytime = 3;
doani();
}
} else if (comA==7) {
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
setstring this.playgani,#s(this.comP);
this.mode = MODE_PLAY;
doani();
this.actiontime = 10;
}
} else if (comA==8) {
setstring this.followperson,#s(this.ePlayer);
setarray this.followpos,0;
this.mode = MODE_FOLLOW;
this.actiontime = -1;
dofollowing();
}
}
function dowalking() {
canwarp2;
doani();

testx = x + (dir==1? -0.5 : dir==3? 0.5 : 0);
testy = y + (dir==0? -0.5 : dir==2? 0.5 : 0);
checkonwall();
if (isonwall==false) {
x = testx;
y = testy;
} else
dir = (dir+2)%4; // turning

this.walkstep++;
if (this.walkstep>=3) {
this.walkstep = 0;
if (random(0,1)<0.5)
dir = int(random(0,4));
}
}
function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}

}

// --- Functions ---

function addCommand() {
i = arraylen(this.commandsE);
setarray this.commandsE,i+1;
setarray this.commandsC,i+1;
setarray this.commandsA,i+1;
setarray this.commandsP,i+1;
this.commandsE[i] = comE;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comC);
}
this.commandsC[i] = j;
this.commandsA[i] = comA;
j = -1;
if (strlen(#s(this.comP))>0) {
j = 0;
while (strlen(#s(this.strings#v(j)))>0) j++;
setstring this.strings#v(j),#s(this.comP);
}
this.commandsP[i] = j;
}
function findCommand() {
i = -1;
for (j=0; j<arraylen(this.commandsE); j++) {
isrightcommand();
if (rightcommand==false) continue;
if (this.commandsA[j]!=comA) continue;
i = j;
break;
}
}
function isrightcommand() {
rightcommand = false;
if (this.commandsE[j]!=comE) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]<0 && strlen(#s(this.comC))>0) return;
if (this.commandsC[j]>=0 &&
!strequals(#s(this.strings#v(this.commandsC[j])),#s(this.comC))) return;
rightcommand = true;
}
function removeCommand() {
newc = arraylen(this.commandsE)-1;
if (i<0 || i>newc)
return;

if (this.commandsC[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsC[i]),;
if (this.commandsP[i]>=0) setstring this.strings#v(this.commandsP[i]),;
while (i<newc) {
this.commandsE[i] = this.commandsE[i+1];
this.commandsC[i] = this.commandsC[i+1];
this.commandsA[i] = this.commandsA[i+1];
this.commandsP[i] = this.commandsP[i+1];
i++;
}
setarray this.commandsE,newc;
setarray this.commandsC,newc;
setarray this.commandsA,newc;
setarray this.commandsP,newc;
}
function parseCommand() {
tokenize #s(this.tempcommand);
comE = -1;
divpos = -1;
comA = -1;

wrongformat = (tokenscount<3);
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (strequals(#t(1),->))
divpos = 1;
else if (strequals(#t(2),->))
divpos = 2;
wrongformat = (divpos<0 || tokenscount<divpos+2);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
for (i=0; i<this.eventscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.event#v(i)),#t(0))) {
comE = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comE<0);
}
if (wrongformat==false) {
if (divpos==2)
setstring this.comC,#t(1);
else
setstring this.comC,;

for (i=0; i<this.actionscount; i++)
if (strequals(#s(this.action#v(i)),#t(divpos+1))) {
comA = i;
break;
}
wrongformat = (comA<0);
}
setstring this.comP,#t(divpos+2);
if (comA==6 && !startswith(emoticon_,#s(this.comP)))
wrongformat = true;
}
function parseAddCommand() {
if (arraylen(this.commandsE)>=this.maxcommands)
message -max #v(this.maxcommands) commands-;
else {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else if (comA==4 && strlen(#s(this.comP))>50)
message -max 50 character for the say action-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0)
removeCommand();
addCommand();
message -command added-;
}
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}
function parseRemoveCommand() {
parseCommand();
if (wrongformat==true)
message -wrong format-;
else {
findCommand();
if (i>=0) {
removeCommand();
message -command removed-;
} else
message -command not found-;
}
setstring this.tempcommand,;
this.saytime = 3;
}

else

ex = players[i].x;

}

function dosliding() {
canwarp2;
doani();

// Set direction
dir = (abs(this.slidex)>=abs(this.slidey)? (this.slidex>=0? 3 : 1) :
(this.slidey>=0? 2 : 0));

// Try to move till the bomy reachs a wall
veclen = (this.slidex^2+this.slidey^2)^0.5;
nx = this.slidex/veclen;
ny = this.slidey/veclen;
teststep = 0.5;

i = 0;
orgx = x;
orgy = y;
while (true) {
if (i+teststep>=veclen)
i = veclen;
else
i += teststep;
testx = orgx+this.slidex*i/veclen;
testy = orgy+this.slidey*i/veclen;

setarray kwall,4;
kwall[0] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+1);
kwall[1] = onwall(testx+0.5,testy+2);
kwall[2] = onwall(testx+1.5,testy+3);
kwall[3] = onwall(testx+2.5,testy+2);
if (true in kwall) {
// Bounce back
if ((this.slidex<0 && kwall[1]==true) || (this.slidex>0 &&
kwall[3]==true))
this.slidex *= -1;
else
x = testx;
if ((this.slidey<0 && kwall[0]==true) || (this.slidey>0 &&
kwall[2]==true))
this.slidey *= -1;
else
y = testy;
break;
}

x = testx;
y = testy;
if (i>=veclen) break;
}

// Make it slower when not in water
if (!onwater(x+1.5,y+2)) {
this.slidex += (this.slidex<0? this.slidesubx : -this.slidesubx);
if (abs(this.slidex)<=this.slidesubx) this.slidex = 0;
this.slidey += (this.slidey<0? this.slidesuby : -this.slidesuby);
if (abs(this.slidey)<=this.slidesuby) this.slidey = 0;
}

if (this.slidex==0 && this.slidey==0)
donormal();
}
function dofollowing() {
;

noowner = true;
with (getplayer(#s(this.followperson))) {
noowner = false;
if (!strequals(#F,#L)) {
// Player leaved the level, so follow him
setarray this.followpos,0;
dir = playerdir;
warpto #F,playerx,playery;
} else {
//
// Follow the player
//
px = playerx;
py = playery;

// Add one step to the list if the player has moved
alen = arraylen(this.followpos);
if (alen<2 || this.followpos[alen-2]!=px || this.followpos[alen-1]!=py)
{
setarray this.followpos,alen+2;
this.followpos[alen] = px;
this.followpos[alen+1] = py;
}
// Only save 4 steps, so delete one entry at the beginning
// if there are too many
if (arraylen(this.followpos)>4*2) {
for (i=0; i<4; i++) {
this.followpos[i*2] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2];
this.followpos[i*2+1] = this.followpos[(i+1)*2+1];
}
setarray this.followpos,4*2;
}

// Get the new position (oldest saved step)
nx = this.followpos[0];
ny = this.followpos[1];

// Setting direction
if (abs(nx-x)>abs(ny-y)) {
if (nx<x) dir = 1; else dir = 3;
} else if (abs(nx-x)<abs(ny-y)) {
if (ny<y) dir = 0; else dir = 2;
}
if (nx==px && ny==py) dir = playerdir;

// Setting animation
if (onwater(nx+1.5,ny+2))
setcharani bomy_kick,;
else if (x==nx && y==ny)
setcharani bomy_idle,;
else
setcharani bomy_walk,;

// Applying the new position
x = nx;
y = ny;
}
}
if (noowner==true)
donormal();
}
function donormal() {
this.playernear = 0;
comA = 2;
doaction();
}

else if (this.mode==MODE_WALK)
setstring this.gani,bomy_walk;
else if (this.mode==MODE_SLIDE)
setstring this.gani,bomy_kick;
else if (this.mode==MODE_HIDE)
setstring this.gani,bomy_hide;
else if (this.mode==MODE_ATTACK)
setstring this.gani,bomy_attack;
else if (this.mode==MODE_PLAY)
setstring this.gani,bomy_#s(this.playgani);
if (strlen(#s(this.emoticon))>0 && this.mode in {0,1,3,4})
setstring this.gani,#s(this.gani)_e,#s(this.emoticon);
setcharani #s(this.gani),;
}

// image: -
// tile: 28,35
// recovered-from-binary: false

NPC - 28 35
// NPC made by Ace2896
function Initialize(){
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #n,Jessica (Soldier);
  setcharprop #2,no-shield.png;
  setcharprop #1,sword2.png;
  setcharprop #3,head999.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,green;
  setcharprop #C2,blue;
  setcharprop #C3,black;
  setcharprop #C4,pink;
  setcharprop #8,body15.png;
  hearts=10;
  this.fullhearts=10;
  this.speed=.5;
  swordpower=5;
  this.radius=1.5;
  this.attackdist=3;
  timeout=.05;
}

function Convert(){
  this.curdist=64;
  for (i=0;i<compuscount;i++){
    if (!compus[i].mode==5||!compus[i].mode==9){
      this.distx=abs(compus[i].x-x);
      this.disty=abs(compus[i].y-y);
      this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.index=i;
      }
    }
  }
  this.testx=compus[this.index].x;
  this.testy=compus[this.index].y;
}
function GetDist(){
  Convert();
  this.distx=abs(this.testx-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.testy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function Direction(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.testy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  Direction();
  MoveCheck();
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    this.attack=1;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function HitCheck(){
  t=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitcompu t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
  t=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitplayer t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
}
function RadialHitDetection(){
  AttackCheck();
  for (this.angle=0;this.count<20;this.angle+=.314){
    this.testx=x+1+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.testy=y+1.3+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.count++;
    HitCheck();
  }
  this.count=0;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.attack=0;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout&&compuscount=0){
  setcharprop #c,I guess thats all of them...;
  sprite=0;
  if (playerhearts!=playerfullhearts){
    lay heart;
    dir=2;
    timeout=0.1;
  }
  if(hearts!=this.fullhearts){
    lay heart;
    sleep 1.5;
    take heart;
    play extra.wav;
    dir=2;
    timeout=0.1;
  }
  if (hearts=this.fullhearts && playerhearts=playerfullhearts){
    walk();
  }
}
if (timeout&&compuscount>0){
  if (this.attack==0){
    Movement();
    RadialHitDetection();
  }else if (this.attack==1)SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  this.attack=0;
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  BounceBack();
}

    if (this.testy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.testx<x)dir=1;
    if (this.testx>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  Direction();
  MoveCheck();
  sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+1-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Convert();
  this.hit=0;
  while(this.hit<5){
    sprite=39;
    this.hit+=.5;
    if (x>this.testx&&!onwall(x+3.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<this.testx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<this.testy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  sprite=40;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  GetDist();
  if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    this.attack=1;
    sprite=9;
  }
}
function HitCheck(){
  t=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitcompu t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
  t=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (t>=0)hitplayer t,swordpower,this.testx,this.testy;
}
function RadialHitDetection(){
  AttackCheck();
  for (this.angle=0;this.count<20;this.angle+=.314){
    this.testx=x+1+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.testy=y+1.3+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
    this.count++;
    HitCheck();
  }
  this.count=0;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else {
    sprite=0;
    this.attack=0;
  }
}
if (playerenters){
  Initialize();
}
if (timeout&&compuscount>0){
  if (this.attack==0){
    Movement();
    RadialHitDetection();
  }else if (this.attack==1)SwordAttack();
  if (hearts>0) timeout=.05;
  else SpinMove();
}
if ((washit||waspelt||exploded||wasshot)&&hearts>0){
  this.attack=0;
  hearts-=playerswordpower;
  BounceBack();
}

function ConvertA(){
  this.testx=this.arrowx[a]+offset[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.testy=this.arrowy[a]+offset[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
}
function FlipArrow(){
  this.arrowp[a]+=.05;
  if (this.ix<6)this.ix+=2;
  else this.ix=0;
  if (this.iy<7)this.iy+=2;
  else this.iy=1;
  this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1]*;
  showimg a,cutters.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowp[a]==0)RemoveArrow();
}
function HitCheck(){
  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
      if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
      else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
      play arrowon.wav;
    }else {
      hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();

  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();

  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
}
function LayItem(){
  i=random(0,100);
  if (i<5) lay2 heart,putx,puty;
  else if (i<10) lay2 bombs,putx,puty;
  else if (i<20) lay2 bluerupee,putx,puty;
  else if (i<35) lay2 greenrupee,putx,puty;
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];

  else showimg a,fireblasts.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){
    n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);

      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;

  if (this.testx<0||this.testy<0||this.testx>63||this.testy>63)RemoveArrow();
}
function RemoveArrow(){

    this.arrowp[b]=this.arrowp[b+1];
    this.onfire[b]=this.onfire[b+1];

  this.arrowx[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowy[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  this.onfire[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;

}

// This is one of the custom bow NPCs
// You can use these to make your own bow-like weapons.
// If you scroll down the script until you see the function "SetVars",
// you'll notice the following variables:
// "this.pow" is the number of half hearts taken off when it hits something
// With "this.wallstop" if it is equal to 1, the arrow will stop when it hits a wall
// "this.cost" is the number of darts it costs to use the weapon
//
// If you would like to make your own graphics for it, follow these simple steps:
// make the images for it by editing the provided graphics;
// scroll down to the function "FlipArrow" and look for the part that says "showimg..."

function ConvertA(){
  this.testx=this.arrowx[a]+offset[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.testy=this.arrowy[a]+offset[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
}
function FlipArrow(){
  this.arrowp[a]+=.05;
  if (this.ix<6)this.ix+=2;
  else this.ix=0;
  if (this.iy<7)this.iy+=2;
  else this.iy=1;
  this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
  this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1]*;
  showimg a,fireballs.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowp[a]==0)RemoveArrow();
}
function HitCheck(){
  ConvertA();
  c=testcompu(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (c>=0){
    hitcompu c,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  p=testplayer(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (p>0){
    if (players[p].dir=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4){
      if (players[p].shieldpower>1)this.arrowdir[a]=(this.arrowdir[a]+2)%4;
      else if (players[p].shieldpower==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
      play arrowon.wav;
    }else {
      hitplayer p,this.pow,this.testx,this.testy;
      RemoveArrow();
    }
  }
  b=testbomb(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (b>=0){
    explodebomb b;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
    callnpc n,washit;
    RemoveArrow();
  }
  e=testexplo(this.testx,this.testy);
  if (e>=0)this.onfire[a]=1;
}
function MoveArrow(){
  this.ix=this.arrowdir[a]*2;
  this.iy=(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1;
  this.arrowx[a]+=dirgo[this.ix];
  this.arrowy[a]+=dirgo[this.iy];
  if (this.onfire[a]!=1)showimg a,fireballs.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  else showimg a,fireblasts.png,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  changeimgpart a,imgvis[this.ix],imgvis[this.iy],imgprt[this.ix],imgprt[this.iy];
  if (this.arrowx[a]<0||this.arrowy[a]<0||this.arrowx[a]>63||this.arrowy[a]>63)RemoveArrow();
  ConvertA();
  if (onwall(this.testx,this.testy)){
    n=testnpc(this.testx,this.testy);
    if (n>=0&&npcs[n].hurtdx==0&&npcs[n].hurtdy==0){
      RemoveArrow();
      callnpc n,washit;
    }else if (this.onfire[a]==1)RemoveArrow();
    else if (this.wallstop==1)this.arrowp[a]=-.15;
  }else HitCheck();
}
function RemoveArrow(){
  if (this.onfire[a]==1){
    this.arrowx[a]-=dirgo[this.arrowdir[a]*2];
    this.arrowy[a]-=dirgo[(this.arrowdir[a]*2)+1];
    putexplosion2 1,1,this.arrowx[a],this.arrowy[a];
  }
  hideimg a;
  for (b=a; b<=this.out; b++) {
    this.arrowx[b]=this.arrowx[b+1];
    this.arrowy[b]=this.arrowy[b+1];
    this.arrowdir[b]=this.arrowdir[b+1];
    this.arrowp[b]=this.arrowp[b+1];
    this.onfire[b]=this.onfire[b+1];
  }
  this.arrowx[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowy[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowdir[this.out]=-1;
  this.arrowp[this.out]=-1;
  this.onfire[this.out]=-1;
  a--;
  this.out--;
  hideimg this.out;
}

    if(this.bally>200&&this.ballupdown=0){
      this.bally=this.bally-1;
    }
    if(this.bally=200&&this.ballupdown=0){
      this.ballupdown=1;
    }
    if(this.bally<240&&this.ballupdown=1){
      this.bally=this.bally+1;
    }
    if(this.bally=240&&this.ballupdown=1){
      this.ballupdown=0;
    }
  }
}
function exit(){
  hideimgs 201,206;
  enabledefmovement;
  this.inuse=0;
  setplayerprop #c,[Pong] Score: #v(this.score) | High: #s(client.pong_high_score);
}

function reload(){
  if(strequals(#s(client.currentweapon),Shotgun)&&!this.shooting&&!this.reloading){
    if(strtofloat(#s(client.shotgunrounds))>0){
      setstring client.shotgunammo,#v(strtofloat(#s(client.shotgunammo))+10);
      setstring client.shotgunrounds,#v(strtofloat(#s(client.shotgunrounds))-1);
      set this.reloading;
      freezeplayer 1;
      timeout=1;
      setani era_shotgun-reload,;
      setplayerprop #c,Shotgun Rounds: #s(client.shotgunrounds);
    }else{
      play bomywalk0.wav;
      setplayerprop #c,No Rounds.;
    }
  }
}
function fire(){
  if(strequals(#s(client.currentweapon),Shotgun)&&!this.shooting&&!this.reloading){
    if(!strtofloat(#s(client.shotgunammo))>2){
      play bomywalk0.wav;
      setplayerprop #c,No Ammo.;
    }else{
      setstring client.shotgunammo,#v(strtofloat(#s(client.shotgunammo))-3);
      set this.shooting;
      freezeplayer 0.7;
      timeout=0.7;
      setani era_shotgun-fire,;
      this.maxangle=.20;
      this.angle=getangle(vecx(playerdir),vecy(playerdir));
      this.x=playerx+vecx(playerdir)*2;
      this.y=(playery-.5)+vecy(playerdir)*2.5;
      setshootparams 1; // Damage
      for(i=0;i<3;i++;) shoot this.x-1,this.y,playerz,this.angle+random(this.maxangle*-1,this.maxangle),0,0,era_shotgun-bullet,;
    }
  }
}
if(timeout){
  unset this.shooting;
  unset this.reloading;
  if(strequals(#s(client.currentweapon),Shotgun)){
    timeout=5;
  }
}

  this.elementon = 1; // The ON and OFF Switch for the Element Showing (0 - FALSE, 1 - TRUE)
  this.fallspeed = .5; // The Slowest Speed at Which the Element Falls (MAX = 1)
  this.elementamount = {200, 3}; // The Concentration and the Array Count Of The Element (C, AC)
  this.fallingdir = {.1,1}; // The Direction and Velocity of the Element ((x,y) Positive Numbers move Right and Down)
  this.falltime = 20; // The time on AVERAGE each Element Takes to Fall

if (timeout) {
  if (this.elementon == 1) {
    for (i=0; i<this.elementamount[1]; i++) {
      for (ii=(this.elementeach*i); ii<(this.elementeach)*(i+1); ii++) {
        if (this.elementarray[(ii*4)+2] >= this.elementarray[(ii*4)+3] || this.elementarray[(ii*4)] >= 64) {
          if (onwater(this.elementarray[ii*4], this.elementarray[(ii*4)+1])) {
            putleaps 5, this.elementarray[ii*4], this.elementarray[(ii*4)+1];
          }
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)] = random(-20,54);
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)+1] = random(-20,54);
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)+3] = random(this.falltime/4,(this.falltime/4)*3);
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)+2] = 0;
          if (this.elementamount[1] >= 4 && this.timer >= this.elementamount[0]*this.elementamount[1]) {
            play thunder.wav;
            this.timer = 0;
          } else {
            this.timer += random((this.elementamount[0]*this.elementamount[1])/10000, (this.elementamount[0]*this.elementamount[1])/8000);
          }
        } else {
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)] += (this.fallingdir[0]*this.fallspeed)+(i/25);
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)+1] += (this.fallingdir[1]*this.fallspeed)+(i/25);
          this.elementarray[(ii*4)+2] += .1;
          showimg ii+100, #s(this.arraygif), this.elementarray[ii*4], this.elementarray[(ii*4)+1];
        }
      }
    }
  }
  timeout = .05;
}

    dy = players[i].y - y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {

      if (dy>0) pdir=2; else pdir=0;

          this.aimy = players[i].y;

onClipEvent (keyDown)
{
    with (_root)
    {
        if (Key.getCode() == 38)
        {
            nextPacDir = 0;
        }
        else if (Key.getCode() == 39)
        {
            nextPacDir = 1;
        }
        else if (Key.getCode() == 40)
        {
            nextPacDir = 2;
        }
        else if (Key.getCode() == 37)
        {
            nextPacDir = 3;
        }
        else if (playing || Key.getCode() == 80 || Key.getCode() == 112)
        {
            if (Ready._visible)
            {
                Ready._visible = false;
                Ready.gotoAndStop(1);
                if (notMute)
                {
                    startBGSnd();
                } // end if
                if (stopped)
                {
                    Pacman.play();
                } // end if
                play();
            }
            else
            {
                stop();
                Ready.gotoAndStop("Paused");
                Ready._visible = true;
                stopAllSound();
                Pacman.stop();
            } // end if
        }
        else if (playing || Key.getCode() == 81 || Key.getCode() == 113 || Key.getCode() == 27)
        {
            quitting = true;
            stop();
            Ready.gotoAndStop("Quit");
            Ready._visible = true;
            stopAllSound();
            Pacman.stop();
        }
        else if (quitting || Key.getCode() == 78 || Key.getCode() == 110)
        {
            quitting = false;
            Ready._visible = false;
            Ready.gotoAndStop(1);
            if (notMute)
            {
                startBGSnd();
            } // end if
            if (stopped)
            {
                Pacman.play();
            } // end if
            play();
        }
        else if (quitting || Key.getCode() == 89 || Key.getCode() == 121)
        {
            quit = true;
            play();
        }
        else if (playing && !Ready._visible || Key.getCode() == 77 || Key.getCode() == 109)
        {
            notMute = !notMute;
            if (notMute)
            {
                startBGSnd();
            }
            else
            {
                stopAllSound();
            } // end if
        }
        else if (Key.getCode() == 76 || Key.getCode() == 108)
        {
            toggleHighQuality();
        } // End of with
    } // end if
}

{
    gotoAndStop(4);

else

    with (Bar)

        _width = 96 * loaded / tot;
        _x = 132 + _width / 2;

    pacStep = 4;

if(timeout){
  if(this.inuse=1){
    disabledefmovement;
    if(keydown(0)){
      this.moving=1;
      if(this.y>200){
        this.y=this.y-2;
        movecomp();
      }
    }
    if(keydown(2)){
      this.moving=1;
      if(this.y<240){
        this.y=this.y+2;
        movecomp();
      }
    }
    if(keydown(5)||keydown(6)){
      exit();
    }
    update();
    moveball();
    moveball();
    moveball();
    movecomp();
    moveupdown();
    update();
    timeout=0.1;
  }else{
    exit();
  }

function update(){
  showimg 202,@|,this.x,this.y;
  changeimgvis 202,4;
  showimg 203,@|,this.compx,this.compy;
  changeimgvis 203,4;
  showimg 204,@,this.ballx,this.bally;
  changeimgvis 204,4;
}
function moveball(){
  if(this.moving=1){
    if(this.balldir=1){
      if(this.ballx<360){
        this.ballx=this.ballx+1;
      }
      if(this.ballx=360){
        if(this.compy in |this.bally-10,this.bally+10|){
          randomupdown();
          this.balldir=0;
        }else{
          say2 You Win!#bPong#bCopyright Agret;
          exit();
        }
      }
    }
    if(this.balldir=0){
      if(this.ballx>260){
        this.ballx=this.ballx-1;
      }
      if(this.ballx=260){
        if(this.y in |this.bally-10,this.bally+10|){
          randomupdown();
          this.balldir=1;
          this.score++;
          showimg 205,@Score: #v(this.score),285,250;
          changeimgvis 205,4;
          if(this.score>strtofloat(#s(client.pong_high_score))){
            setstring client.pong_high_score,#v(this.score);
          }
          showimg 206,@High: #s(client.pong_high_score),285,270;
          changeimgvis 206,4;
        }else{
          say2 You Lose!#bPong#bCopyright Agret;
          exit();
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
function movecomp(){
  if(this.compy<this.bally){
    this.compy=this.compy+1.5;
  }
  if(this.compy>this.bally){
    this.compy=this.compy-1.5;
  }
}
function randomupdown(){
  this.ballupdown=random(0,10);
  if(this.ballupdown>4){this.ballupdown=1;}else{this.ballupdown=0;}
}
function moveupdown(){
  if(this.moving=1){
    if(this.bally>200&&this.ballupdown=0){
      this.bally=this.bally-1;
    }
    if(this.bally=200&&this.ballupdown=0){
      this.ballupdown=1;
    }
    if(this.bally<240&&this.ballupdown=1){
      this.bally=this.bally+1;
    }
    if(this.bally=240&&this.ballupdown=1){
      this.ballupdown=0;
    }
  }
}
function exit(){
  hideimgs 201,206;
  enabledefmovement;
  this.inuse=0;
  setplayerprop #c,[Pong] Score: #v(this.score) | High: #s(client.pong_high_score);
}

function hatoff() {
   hideimgs 0,6;
   setani hatoff,;
   freezeplayer 0.5;
   sleep 0.4;
   setplayerprop #P1,;
}

/**********************
 * Visual Functions
 *  Display
 **********************/

function display(){
  for (i=0;i<5;i++){
    showimg i,hat#v(this.hats[(this.hatloc + i - 2)%this.amm]).png,
    playerx + 1.5 + cos((3.16/4 * i)-3.16)*3 - 1.5,
      playery + 1 + sin((3.16/4 * i)-3.16)*3 - 1.5;
    changeimgvis i,2;
    changeimgpart i,2*48,0,48,48;
  }
  if (this.qua[(this.hatloc)%this.amm] > 0)
    showtext 6,playerx + 1.5,playery - 0.5,garamond,cb,#v(this.hats[this.hatloc%this.amm]):#v(this.qua[(this.hatloc)%this.amm]);
  else
    showtext 6,playerx + 1.5,playery - 0.5,garamond,cb,Free;
  changeimgvis 6,3;
  changeimgzoom 6,0.6;
}

/**********************
 * Operating Functions:
 *  GetKeys -- Puts Keys in Arrays
 *  Hats2Array -- Puts Hats in Arrays
 **********************/

function getkeys(){
  this.key = 0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<10;this.i++){
    this.keytime[this.i] = keydown(this.i) == 1 ? this.keytime[this.i] + 1 : 0;
    this.key += keydown(this.i);
  }
  this.keytime[10] = this.key == 0 ? this.keytime[10] + 1 : 0;
}

function hatarray(){
  this.hats = {0,2,3};
  this.qua = {0,0,0};
  start = 3;

  for (this.i=0;this.i<sarraylen(clientr.hats);this.i++){
    hatloc = -1;
    hatn = strtofloat(#I(clientr.hats,this.i));
    for (this.j=0;this.j<start;this.j++){
      if (this.hats[this.j] == hatn){
        hatloc = this.j;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (hatloc != -1){
      this.qua[hatloc] ++;
    } else {
      setarray this.hats,start+1;
      setarray this.qua,start+1;
      this.hats[start] = hatn;
      this.qua[start] = 1;
      start++;
    }
  }
  this.amm = start;
}

  if (mousex in |10,20| && mousey in |10,20|){
    this.opselect = 1;
  }
  else this.opselect = 0;

    changeimgcolors 202,1,0,0,1;
  }
  elseif (!this.opselect == 1){
    changeimgcolors 202,1,1,1,1;
