  if (strequals(#c,craft zelat)) this.craftitem = 5;

  dx = x-playerx;
  dy = y-playery;
  rightdist = (abs(dx)<=8 && abs(dy)<=8);
  rightpdir = (abs(dx)>abs(dy)? (dx<=0? 1 : 3) : (dy<0? 0 : 2));

  if (this.craftitem>=1 && rightdist==true && playerdir==rightpdir) {
    startcrafting = false;
    setplayerprop #c,;
    if (this.craftitem==1) {
      stonecount = strtofloat(#s(uncrafteddiamond));
      if (stonecount<1)
        say2
You don't have uncrafted#b
  diamond gems!;
      else {
        setstring uncrafteddiamond,#v(stonecount-1);
        startcrafting = true;
      }
    }
    if (this.craftitem==2) {
      stonecount = strtofloat(#s(uncrafteddurby));
      if (stonecount<1)
        say2
You don't have uncrafted#b
  durby gems!;
      else {
        setstring uncrafteddurby,#v(stonecount-1);
        startcrafting = true;
      }
    }
    if (this.craftitem==3) {
      stonecount = strtofloat(#s(uncraftedgold));
      if (stonecount<1)
        say2
You don't have uncrafted#b
  gold arc!;
      else {
        setstring uncraftedgold,#v(stonecount-1);
        startcrafting = true;
      }
    }
    if (this.craftitem==4) {
      stonecount = strtofloat(#s(uncraftediron));
      if (stonecount<1)
        say2
You don't have uncrafted#b
  iron arc!;
      else {
        setstring uncraftediron,#v(stonecount-1);
        startcrafting = true;
      }
    }
    if (this.craftitem==5) {
      stonecount = strtofloat(#s(uncraftedzelat));
      if (stonecount<1)
        say2
You don't have uncrafted#b
  zelat gems!;
      else {
        setstring uncraftedzelat,#v(stonecount-1);
        startcrafting = true;
      }
    }
    if (startcrafting==true) {
      setcharani craftgem,#v(5+this.craftitem);
      show;
      this.full = true;
      this.neededhits = level.crafthitsneeded[this.craftitem-1];
      this.hits = 0;
      setstring this.owner,#a;
      message stone placed by #s(this.owner);
      level.crafton[this.craftnum] = true;
      timeout = 10;
    }
  }
}
if (actionhammerhit && this.full==true && this.givingitem==false) {
  this.hitterid = strtofloat(#p(1));
  gethitter();
  if (hitter>=0) {
    ownerexists = false;
    with (getplayer(#s(this.owner))) {
      ownerexists = true;
    }
    with (players[hitter]) {
      hammer = strtofloat(#p(0));
      if (hammer>0) {
        this.hits += 1/hammer;
        if (ownerexists==false) {
          setstring this.owner,#a;
          message new owner: #s(this.owner);
        } else
          displaycraft();
      }
    }
    if (this.hits>=this.neededhits) {
      this.givingitem = true;
      with (getplayer(#s(this.owner))) {
        if (this.craftitem==1)
          setstring crafteddiamond,#v(strtofloat(#s(crafteddiamond))+1);
        if (this.craftitem==2)
          setstring crafteddurby,#v(strtofloat(#s(crafteddurby))+1);
        if (this.craftitem==3)
          setstring craftedgold,#v(strtofloat(#s(craftedgold))+1);
        if (this.craftitem==4)
          setstring craftediron,#v(strtofloat(#s(craftediron))+1);
        if (this.craftitem==5)
          setstring craftedzelat,#v(strtofloat(#s(craftedzelat))+1);
        setani jgotgem,#v(this.craftitem);
        freezeplayer2;
      }
      sleep 2;
      with (getplayer(#s(this.owner))) {
        unfreezeplayer;
      }
      this.full = false;
      this.givingitem = false;
      level.crafton[this.craftnum] = false;
      hide;
    } else
      timeout = 10;
  }
}
if (timeout && this.full==true) {
  setstring this.owner,;
  message (no owner);
  sleep 3;
  displaycraft();
}
if (playerchats && this.full==true && strequals(#c,show owner)) {
  message owner: #s(this.owner);
}
function gethitter() {
  hitter = -1;
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++)
    if (players[i].id==this.hitterid) {
      hitter = i;
      break;
    }
}
function displaycraft() {
  if (this.full==true) {
    disp = int(100*this.hits/this.neededhits);
    if (disp>100) disp = 100;
    message #v(disp) %;
  } else
    message;
}

}

          say2

        else {

          if (npcindex>=0) {
            trashx = this.trashx-0.5;
            trashy = this.trashy-1;
            with (npcs[npcindex]) {
              if (playerrupees<this.price)
                say2
You don't have enough money#b
to buy this item!;
              else {
                give = true;
                if (strequals(#m(-1),foodnpc)) {
                  if (this.item<4) {
                    freebottle = -1;
                    for (i=1; i<=3; i++) if (strlen(#s(bottle#v(i)))<=0) {
                      freebottle = i;
                      break;
                    }
                    if (freebottle<0) give = false;
                  } else if (this.item==4) {
                    breadcount = strtofloat(#s(breadcount));
                    if (breadcount>=3) give = false;
                  } else if (this.item==5) {
                    piecount = strtofloat(#s(piecount));
                    if (piecount>=1) give = false;
                  }
                }

                if (give==false)
                  say2
You cannot carry more of this;
                else {
                  playerrupees -= this.price;

                  gavemoney = false;
                  with (getplayer(#s(this.owner))) {
                    gavemoney = true;
                    playerrupees += this.price;
                  }
                  if (gavemoney==false) {
                    setstring server.temp,#s(this.owner);
                    price = this.price;

                    putnpc2 trashx,trashy,{
join gralats;
                    };
                    with (npcs[npcscount-1]) {
                      setstring this.owner,#s(server.temp);
                      rupees = price;
                      this.laytime = timevar;
                    }
                    setstring server.temp,;
                  }

                  x = trashx;
                  y = trashy;
                  this.blocked = false;
                  setstring this.owner,#a;
                  this.price = 0;
                  this.laytime = timevar;
                  message;
                  blockagain;
                  say2
Thanks for buying this item!#b
Go to the basket on the left#b
side of this stand to get it;
                }
              }
            }
          } else
            say2
There is no item on that#b
spot;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
function testowner() {
  i = this.table;
  isowner = false;
  with (getnpc(Market-Owner)) {
    isowner = (strequals(#s(this.table#v(i).owner),#a) || strequals(#g,Staff));
  }
}
function finditem() {
  rx = x+2;
  ry = y-2;
  rw = 10;
  rh = 6;
  npcindex = -1;
  for (i=0; i<npcscount; i++) {
    with (npcs[i]) {
      if (strcontains(foodnpc itemnpc hatnpc vdollnpc,#m(-1)) && strlen(#s(this.owner))<=0) {
        if (x+1 in |rx,rx+rw| && y+1 in |ry,ry+rh|) {
          npcindex = i;
        }
      }
    }
    if (npcindex>=0)
      break;
  }
}
function findsellitem() {
  putx = x + 0.5 + (spot-1)*2;
  puty = y + 2;
  npcindex = -1;
  for (i=0; i<npcscount; i++) {
    with (npcs[i]) {
      if (strcontains(foodnpc itemnpc hatnpc vdollnpc,#m(-1)) && x==putx && y==puty)
        npcindex = i;
    }
    if (npcindex>=0)
      break;
  }
}
function takeitemsdown() {
  j = 1;
  while (j<=6) {
    spot = j;
    findsellitem();
    trashx = this.trashx-0.5;
    trashy = this.trashy-1;
    if (npcindex>=0) {
      with (npcs[npcindex]) {
        x = trashx;
        y = trashy;
        this.blocked = false;
        this.price = 0;
        this.laytime = timevar;
        message;
        blockagain;
      }
    } else
      j++;
  }
}
function closestand() {
  takeitemsdown();
  hideimg 10;
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++) if (players[i].id>0) {
    with (players[i]) {
      checkwarpout();
    }
  }
}
function checkwarpout() {
  rx = x+2;
  ry = y-2;
  rw = 10;
  rh = 6;
  if (playerx+1.5 in |rx,rx+rw| && playery+2 in |ry,ry+rh|) {
    playerx = x - 2.5;
    playerdir = 1;
  }
}

function hit() {
  if (random(0,strtofloat(#p(1)))<this.hitchance) {
    ownerexists = false;
    this.hitterid = strtofloat(#p(2));
    gethitter();
    this.step++;
    updateimg();

    if (this.step==6) {
      gethitter();
      if (hitter>=0) with (players[hitter]) {
        this.gotgem = true;
        if (this.type==1)
          setstring uncrafteddiamond,#v(strtofloat(#s(uncrafteddiamond))+1);
        else if (this.type==2)
          setstring uncrafteddurby,#v(strtofloat(#s(uncrafteddurby))+1);
        else if (this.type==3)
          setstring uncraftedgold,#v(strtofloat(#s(uncraftedgold))+1);
        else if (this.type==4)
          setstring uncraftediron,#v(strtofloat(#s(uncraftediron))+1);
        else if (this.type==5)
          setstring uncraftediron,#v(strtofloat(#s(uncraftedzelat))+1);
        else this.gotgem = false;
        if (this.gotgem==true) {
          setani jgotgem,#v(5+this.type);
          freezeplayer2;
        }
      }
      sleep 2;
      gethitter();
      if (hitter>=0) with (players[hitter]) {
        unfreezeplayer;
      }
    }
  }
}

function gethitter() {
  hitter = -1;
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++)
      if (players[i].id==this.hitterid) {
    hitter = i;
    break;
  }
}

  for (i=0; i<11; i++) this.oldkey[i] = keydown(i);

// Walking stuff
if (timeout) {
  this.newx = x + vecx(dir)*this.speed;
  this.newy = y + vecy(dir)*this.speed;

  // Test for player in front and stop if there is one
  this.waitingforplayer = false;
  while (true) {
    i = testplayer(this.newx+1.5+vecx(dir),this.newy+2+vecy(dir));
    if (i<0 || players[i].id<=0) break;

    if (this.waitingforplayer==false) {
      this.waitingforplayer = true;
      sprite = 0;

      with (players[i]) {
        if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
          message Grrr... always you bomys!;
          setcharani sword,;
        } else if (playerap<20) {
          message Grrr... always you PKers!;
          hitobjects 5,x+1.5+vecx(dir*2),y+2+vecy(dir*2);
          setcharani sword,;
        }
          message Please let me through!;
      }
    }
    sleep 1;
  }
  if (this.waitingforplayer==true) {
    this.waitingforplayer = false;
    message;
  }

  // Follow the way specified in this.ways
  sprite = (sprite%8)+1;
  x = this.newx;
  y = this.newy;
  this.distance += this.speed;
  if (this.distance>=this.distancetogo) {
    this.turn++;
    if (this.turn*2>=arraylen(this.ways))
      this.turn = 0;
    dir = this.ways[this.turn*2];
    this.distancetogo = this.ways[this.turn*2+1];
    this.distance = 0;
  }
  timeout = 0.1;
}

  }

function checkneeds() {
  needsit = false;
  with (getplayer(#s(this.buyer))) {
    if (this.type in {8,9,10,11,12,15,16}) {
      // Things you can only have one time
      needsit = false;
      checkhascount();
      needsit = (hascount==false);
    } else if (this.type in {17,18,19}) {
      needsit = (strtofloat(#s(birdnet))<(this.type-16));
    } else if (this.type in {20,21,22}) {
      needsit = (strtofloat(#s(bait))<(this.type-19));
    } else
      needsit = true;
  }
}

    addweapon Metal Hammer;
  else if (this.type==12)

function resetplayer() {
  playerx=this.x;playery=this.y;playerhearts=this.hearts;}
if (isweapon) {
  if (weaponfired&&playermp=>0){
    playermp-=0;
    this.hearts=playerhearts;
    this.x=playerx;
    this.y=playery;
    this.wave = 3;
    this.max_time = 10;
    playersprite =24;
    this.mode=1;
    this.radius = 3;
    this.active =0;
    this.flysteps = 20;
    this.flyangle = 0;
    timeout=.05;
    freezeplayer 1.5;
  }
  if (timeout) {
    x=playerx;
    y=playery;
    if (this.mode==1||this.mode==2) {
      for (this.i=0; this.i<this.wave; this.i++) {
        this.angleadd = 2*3.14*this.i/this.wave;
        this.imgx = playerx+1.5-0.68+cos(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*this.radius;
        this.imgy = playery+1.5-0.68-sin(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*this.radius;
        putexplosion2 3,1,this.imgx,this.imgy;
        playerhearts=this.hearts;
        this.imgx2 = playerx+1.5-0.68+sin(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*this.radius;
        this.imgy2 = playery+1.5-0.68-cos(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*this.radius;
        putexplosion2 3,1,this.imgx2,this.imgy2;
        playerhearts=this.hearts;
      }
      if (this.mode==1) {
        this.radius ++;
        this.active ++;
      }
      if (this.mode==2) {
        this.radius --;
        this.active --;
      }
      if (this.active>=this.max_time+1&&this.mode==1) {
        this.mode=2;
      }
      if (this.active<=-1&&this.mode==2) {
        this.mode=3;
      }
      this.flyangle += 3.14/this.flysteps;
    }
    if (this.mode==3) {
      if (playery>-2) {
        spiralup();
        hideplayer .1;
        playersprite=37;
        playery --;
      }
      else if (playery<=-1) {
        this.mode=0;
        playersprite=0;
        resetplayer();
      }
    }
    if (this.mode>0) {
      timeout = 0.05;
    }
  }
  function spiralup() {
    for (this.i=0; this.i<this.wave; this.i++) {
      this.angleadd = 2*3.14*this.i/this.wave;
      this.spiralx = playerx+1.5-0.68+cos(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*2;
      this.spiraly = playery+1.5-0.68-sin(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*2;
      putexplosion2 3,.1,this.spiralx,this.spiraly;
      putexplosion2 3,.1,this.spiralx,this.spiraly;
      playerhearts=this.hearts;
      this.spiralx2 = playerx+1.5-0.68+sin(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*2;
      this.spiraly2 = playery+1.5-0.68-cos(this.flyangle+this.angleadd)*2;
      putexplosion2 3,.1,this.spiralx2,this.spiraly2;
      putexplosion2 3,.1,this.spiralx,this.spiraly;
      playerhearts=this.hearts;
    }
    this.flyangle += 3.14/this.flysteps;
  }
}

if (timeout && (this.mode==0 || this.mode==2)) {
  // Look for baddies
  mindist = 1000;
  for (i=0; i<compuscount; i++)
      if (compus[i].power>0) {
    dx = compus[i].x - x;
    dy = compus[i].y - y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) pdir=3; else pdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) pdir=2; else pdir=0;
    }
    if (pdir==dir) {
      dist = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
      if (dist<mindist) {
        cansee = 1;
        if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) k = int(abs(dx));
        else k = int(abs(dy));
        for (j=0; j<=k-2; j++)
          if (onwall(x+1.5+dx*j/k,y+2+dy*j/k)) cansee = 0;
        if (cansee!=0) {
          mindist = dist;
          aimplayer = i;
          this.aimx = compus[i].x;
          this.aimy = compus[i].y;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (mindist<=3) {
    this.runcounter = -1;
    this.mode = 3; // SLAYING
    setcharani sword,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  } else if (mindist<20) {
    if (this.mode!=2) message ;
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
  } else timeout = 0.05;

  }
  message;
  timeout = 0.05;

if (timeout && this.mode==2) { // HUNTING
  setcharani walk,;
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>0 && aimplayer<compuscount && compus[aimplayer].power>0) {
    // Get new direction
    dx = compus[aimplayer].x-x;
    dy = compus[aimplayer].y-y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) dir=3; else dir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) dir=2; else dir=0;
    }

    // Test if we can do a step
    dx = this.aimx-x;
    dy = this.aimy-y;
    if (abs(dx)<=1 && abs(dy)<=1) {
      this.aimx = compus[aimplayer].x;;
      this.aimy = compus[aimplayer].y;
      dx = this.aimx-x;
      dy = this.aimy-y;
    }
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) testdir=3; else testdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) testdir=2; else testdir=0;
    }
    len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
    addx = (dx/len)*this.huntspeed;
    addy = (dy/len)*this.huntspeed;
    testx = x + 1.5;
    testy = y + 2;
    if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy+addy)) {
      // Do a step
      x += addx;
      y += addy;
   } else if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy)) x += addx;
   else if (!onwall(testx,testy+addy)) y += addy;
  } else {

// ===== 04_ultimatenpcpack/ultimatenpcpack1_carraceevent/carrace1__090__9_17.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: ultimatenpcpack1/carraceevent/carrace1.nw
// npc-index: 90
// header: NPC draisineicon.png 9 17
// image: draisineicon.png
// tile: 9,17
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: b1e1a2cc50e0

NPC draisineicon.png 9 17
if (created && !isweapon) {
  setshape 1,32,32;
  message Draisine;
}
if (playertouchsme) {
  toweapons Draisine;
  hide;
  sleep 3;
  show;
}

if (created && isweapon) {
  this.raildirs = {1,3, 0,2, 2,3, 1,2, 0,3, 1,0};
  this.acc = 0.25;
  this.friction = 0.97;
  this.maxspeed = 2;
}
if (weaponfired) {
  if (this.on==false) {
    this.speed = 0;
    this.waypos = 0;
    searchforrails();
    if (this.on==true)
      this.waypos = 2;
  }
}
function searchforrails() {
  tx = playerx+1.5;
  ty = playery+2;
  this.outdir = -1;
  this.oldrailx = this.railx;
  this.oldraily = this.raily;

  pushdir = playerdir;
  if (!keydown(pushdir)) {
    if (keydown((pushdir+1)%4))
      pushdir = (pushdir+1)%4;
    if (keydown((pushdir-1)%4))
      pushdir = (pushdir-1)%4;
  }

  for (i=0; i<npcscount; i++) {
    nx = npcs[i].x;
    ny = npcs[i].y;
    indir = -1;
    outdir = -1;
    if (npcs[i].save[9]==1 && tx in |nx,nx+4> && ty in |ny,ny+4>) {
      type = npcs[i].save[0];
      d1 = this.raildirs[type*2];
      d2 = this.raildirs[type*2+1];
      oppdir = (playerdir+2)%4;
      if (d1==oppdir) {
        indir = d1;
        outdir = d2;
      } else if (d2==oppdir) {
        indir = d2;
        outdir = d1;
      }
    }
    if (outdir>=0) {
      if (this.outdir<0 || outdir==pushdir || (this.outdir!=pushdir && outdir==playerdir)) {
        this.railx = nx;
        this.raily = ny;
        this.indir = indir;
        this.outdir = outdir;
        if (outdir==pushdir)
          break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (this.outdir>=0) {
    if (this.waypos>0) {
      wayposset = false;
      if (this.indir in {0,2}) {
        playerx = this.railx+0.5;
        this.waypos -= abs(this.raily-this.oldraily);
        wayposset = true;
      }
      if (this.indir in {1,3}) {
        playery = this.raily;
        this.waypos -= abs(this.railx-this.oldrailx);
        wayposset = true;
      }
      if (wayposset==false) {
        if (this.waypos>=4)
          this.waypos -= 4;
        else
          this.waypos = 0;
      }
    }

    this.on = true;
    disabledefmovement;
    if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy))
      set disablebomymovement;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
function turnoff() {
  this.on = false;
  enabledefmovement;
  if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
    unset disablebomymovement;
    setani bomy_idle,;
  } else
    setani idle,;
  stopsound train.wav;
}
function setanimation() {
  if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
    if (this.speed==0)
      setani bomy_draisine,;
    else
      setani bomy_draisine2,;
  } else {
    if (this.speed==0)
      setani draisine,;
    else
      setani draisine2,;
  }
}



if (timeout && this.on==true) {
  if (keydown(6))
    turnoff();
  else {
    freezeplayer 0.05;
    if (keydown(5)) {
      if (this.speedkeydown==false) {
        this.speed += this.acc;
        if (this.speed>this.maxspeed)
          this.speed = this.maxspeed;
        playlooped train.wav;
      }
      this.speedkeydown = true;
    } else {
      this.speedkeydown = false;
    }

    tox = this.railx+0.5+vecx(this.indir)*2;
    toy = this.raily+vecy(this.indir)*2;
    isstraight = (this.indir==(this.outdir+2)%4);
    if (isstraight==true) {
      tox += this.waypos * vecx(this.outdir);
      toy += this.waypos * vecy(this.outdir);
    } else {
      w = this.waypos/4*3.14/2;
      dside = 1-cos(w);
      dforward = sin(w);

      fdir = (this.indir+2)%4;
      tox += dforward*2*vecx(fdir);
      toy += dforward*2*vecy(fdir);

      tox += dside*2*vecx(this.outdir);
      toy += dside*2*vecy(this.outdir);
    }
    playerx = tox;
    playery = toy;

    if (!(playerx+1.5 in |this.railx,this.railx+4| && playery+2 in |this.raily,this.raily+4|)
        || (isstraight==true && this.speed>0)) {
      this.on = false;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==false)
        turnoff();
    } else
      timeout = 0.05;

    if (this.on==true) {
      addspeed = this.speed;
      if (!(playerx+1.5,playery+2 in |4,60|) && addspeed>1)
        addspeed = 1;
      this.waypos += addspeed;
      if (this.waypos>=2) playerdir = this.outdir;
      this.speed *= this.friction;
      if (this.speed<0.05)
        this.speed = 0;
      if (this.speed==0)
        stopsound train.wav;
      setanimation();
    }
  }
}
if (playerenters && isweapon) {
  if (this.on==true) {
    if (playerx<-1) playerx = -1;
    if (playerx>62) playerx = 62;
    if (playery<-1.5) playery = -1.5;
    if (playery>61.5) playery = 61.5;
    // Wait 10 seconds till the rail npcs might appear
    for (this.i=0; this.i<10; this.i+=0.05) {
      this.on = false;
      this.waypos = 0;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==true) {
        this.waypos = 2;
        break;
      }
      sleep 0.05;
    }
    if (this.on==false)
      turnoff();
  }
}

      this.on = false;
      this.waypos = 0;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==true) {
        this.waypos = 2;
        break;
      }
      sleep 0.05;
    }
    if (this.on==false)
      turnoff();
  }
}

    this.ally[i]=players[i].y;
    this.allbombs[i]=players[i].bombs;
    this.alldarts[i]=players[i].darts;
    this.allhearts[i]=players[i].hearts;
    this.allfullhearts[i]=players[i].fullhearts;
    this.allrupees[i]=players[i].rupees;
  }
}

  setarray this.allrupees,playerscount;

    this.allx[i]=players[i].x;
    this.ally[i]=players[i].y;
    this.allbombs[i]=players[i].bombs;
    this.alldarts[i]=players[i].darts;
    this.allhearts[i]=players[i].hearts;
    this.allfullhearts[i]=players[i].fullhearts;
    this.allrupees[i]=players[i].rupees;
  }
}

  this.raildirs = {1,3, 0,2, 2,3, 1,2, 0,3, 1,0};
  this.acc = 0.25;
  this.friction = 0.97;
  this.maxspeed = 2;
}
if (weaponfired) {
  if (this.on==false) {
    this.speed = 0;
    this.waypos = 0;
    searchforrails();
    if (this.on==true)
      this.waypos = 2;
  }

function searchforrails() {
  tx = playerx+1.5;
  ty = playery+2;
  this.outdir = -1;
  this.oldrailx = this.railx;
  this.oldraily = this.raily;

  pushdir = playerdir;
  if (!keydown(pushdir)) {
    if (keydown((pushdir+1)%4))
      pushdir = (pushdir+1)%4;
    if (keydown((pushdir-1)%4))
      pushdir = (pushdir-1)%4;
  }

  for (i=0; i<npcscount; i++) {
    nx = npcs[i].x;
    ny = npcs[i].y;
    indir = -1;
    outdir = -1;
    if (npcs[i].save[9]==1 && tx in |nx,nx+4> && ty in |ny,ny+4>) {
      type = npcs[i].save[0];
      d1 = this.raildirs[type*2];
      d2 = this.raildirs[type*2+1];
      oppdir = (playerdir+2)%4;

      if (d1==oppdir) {
        indir = d1;
        outdir = d2;
      } else if (d2==oppdir) {
        indir = d2;
        outdir = d1;
      }
    }
    if (outdir>=0) {
      if (this.outdir<0 || outdir==pushdir || (this.outdir!=pushdir && outdir==playerdir)) {
        this.railx = nx;
        this.raily = ny;
        this.indir = indir;
        this.outdir = outdir;
        if (outdir==pushdir)
          break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (this.outdir>=0) {
    if (this.waypos>0) {
      wayposset = false;
      if (this.indir in {0,2}) {
        playerx = this.railx+0.5;
        this.waypos -= abs(this.raily-this.oldraily);
        wayposset = true;
      }
      if (this.indir in {1,3}) {
        playery = this.raily;
        this.waypos -= abs(this.railx-this.oldrailx);
        wayposset = true;
      }
      if (wayposset==false) {
        if (this.waypos>=4)
          this.waypos -= 4;
        else
          this.waypos = 0;
      }
    }

    this.on = true;
    disabledefmovement;
    if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy))
      set disablebomymovement;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
function turnoff() {
  this.on = false;
  enabledefmovement;
  if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
    unset disablebomymovement;
    setani bomy_idle,;
  } else
    setani idle,;
  stopsound train.wav;
}
function setanimation() {
  if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
    if (this.speed==0)
      setani bomy_draisine,;
    else
      setani bomy_draisine2,;
  } else {
    if (this.speed==0)
      setani draisine,;
    else
      setani draisine2,;
  }
}



if (timeout && this.on==true) {
  if (keydown(6))
    turnoff();
  else {
    freezeplayer 0.05;
    if (keydown(5)) {
      if (this.speedkeydown==false) {
        this.speed += this.acc;
        if (this.speed>this.maxspeed)
          this.speed = this.maxspeed;
        playlooped train.wav;
      }
      this.speedkeydown = true;
    } else {
      this.speedkeydown = false;
    }

    tox = this.railx+0.5+vecx(this.indir)*2;
    toy = this.raily+vecy(this.indir)*2;
    isstraight = (this.indir==(this.outdir+2)%4);
    if (isstraight==true) {
      tox += this.waypos * vecx(this.outdir);
      toy += this.waypos * vecy(this.outdir);
    } else {
      w = this.waypos/4*3.14/2;
      dside = 1-cos(w);
      dforward = sin(w);

      fdir = (this.indir+2)%4;
      tox += dforward*2*vecx(fdir);
      toy += dforward*2*vecy(fdir);

      tox += dside*2*vecx(this.outdir);
      toy += dside*2*vecy(this.outdir);
    }
    playerx = tox;
    playery = toy;

    if (!(playerx+1.5 in |this.railx,this.railx+4| && playery+2 in |this.raily,this.raily+4|)
        || (isstraight==true && this.speed>0)) {
      this.on = false;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==false)
        turnoff();
    } else
      timeout = 0.05;

    if (this.on==true) {
      addspeed = this.speed;
      if (!(playerx+1.5,playery+2 in |4,60|) && addspeed>1)
        addspeed = 1;
      this.waypos += addspeed;
      if (this.waypos>=2) playerdir = this.outdir;
      this.speed *= this.friction;
      if (this.speed<0.05)
        this.speed = 0;
      if (this.speed==0)
        stopsound train.wav;
      setanimation();
    }
  }
}
if (playerenters && isweapon) {
  if (this.on==true) {
    if (playerx<-1) playerx = -1;
    if (playerx>62) playerx = 62;
    if (playery<-1.5) playery = -1.5;
    if (playery>61.5) playery = 61.5;
    // Wait 10 seconds till the rail npcs might appear
    for (this.i=0; this.i<10; this.i+=0.05) {
      this.on = false;
      this.waypos = 0;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==true) {
        this.waypos = 2;
        break;
      }
      sleep 0.05;
    }
    if (this.on==false)
      turnoff();
  }
}

  this.chainlinks=25;

if (playerenters || wasthrown) {
  // Initialize the this. variables
  dirgo = {0,-1,-1,0,0,1,1,0};
  timeout = 0.05;
  this.walkmode = 1;
  if (wasthrown && this.walkmode>1) this.walkmode = 1;
  this.x1 = 0;
  this.x2 = 63;
  this.y1 = 0;
  this.y2 = 63;
  this.speed = 0.3;
  this.mode = 0;
  setcharani idle,;
  this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
}

// Walking stuff
if (timeout && this.mode==0) { // WALKING
  setcharani walk,;
  newx = x + dirgo[dir*2] * this.speed;
  newy = y + dirgo[dir*2+1] * this.speed;
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.walkmode==1) { // RANDOM
    if (this.runcounter>0) {
      testx = newx + 1.5 + dirgo[dir*2];
      testy = newy + 2+ dirgo[dir*2+1];
      if (onwall(testx,testy)) {
        dir = (dir+2)%4;
        this.runcounter = int(random(0,60));
      } else {
        x = newx;
        y = newy;
      }
    } else {
      this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
      dir = (dir+1+int(random(0,2))*2)%4;
    }
  } else if (this.walkmode==2) { // LEFTRIGHT
    if (dir!=1 && dir!=3) dir = 3;
    else {
      x = newx;
      y = newy;
      if ((dir==1 && x<=this.x1) || (dir==3 && x>=this.x2))
        dir = (dir+2)%4;
    }
  } else if (this.walkmode==3) { // UPDOWN
    if (dir!=0 && dir!=2) dir = 2;
    else {
      x = newx;
      y = newy;
      if ((dir==0 && y<=this.y1) || (dir==2 && y>=this.y2))
        dir = (dir+2)%4;
    }
  } else if (this.walkmode==4) { // RECTANGLE
    x = newx;
    y = newy;
    if ((dir==0 && y<=this.y1) || (dir==1 && x<=this.x1) ||
        (dir==2 && y>=this.y2) || (dir==3 && x>=this.x2))
      dir = (dir+3)%4;
  }
  if (this.walkmode>1 && this.runcounter<=0)
    this.runcounter = 20;
  message;
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (playerenters || timeout) {
  this.trapx=x+1;
  this.trapy=y+1.5;
  playerstats();
  if (this.dist>this.chainlength) {
    players[0].x=this.trapx+(cos(this.angle)*this.chainlength)-1;
    players[0].y=this.trapy+(sin(this.angle)*this.chainlength)-1.5;
  }
  for (this.i=0; this.i<this.chainlinks; this.i++) showimg this.i,wmace0.gif,this.trapx+cos(this.angle)*(this.i*(this.dist/this.chainlinks)),this.trapy+sin(this.angle)*(this.i*(this.dist/this.chainlinks));
  timeout=.05;
}
function playerstats() {
  this.distx=abs((players[0].x+1)-this.trapx);
  this.disty=abs((players[0].y+1.5)-this.trapy);
  this.dist=((this.distx^2)+(this.disty^2))^.5;
  this.slope=this.disty/this.distx;
  if ((players[0].x+1)>this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)>this.trapy) this.angle=arctan(this.slope);
  if ((players[0].x+1)<this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)>this.trapy) this.angle=(3.1415926535897932384626433832795-(arctan(this.slope)));
  if ((players[0].x+1)<this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)<this.trapy) this.angle=(3.1415926535897932384626433832795+(arctan(this.slope)));
  if ((players[0].x+1)>this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)<this.trapy) this.angle=(6.28318530717958647692528676655901-(arctan(this.slope)));
  if ((players[0].x+1)==this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)>this.trapy) this.angle=1.57079632679489661923132169163975;
  if ((players[0].x+1)==this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)<this.trapy) this.angle=4.71238898038468985769396507491925;
  if ((players[0].x+1)>this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)==this.trapy) this.angle=0;
  if ((players[0].x+1)<this.trapx && (players[0].y+1.5)==this.trapy) this.angle=3.1415926535897932384626433832795;
}

  message ;

function scanOpen(){
  if (this.targetC[0] == this.focusC[0] && this.targetC[1] == this.focusC[1]){
    message ;
    setstring this.path,;
    hideimg 300;
    setcharani walk,;
    this.nodeParent = this.parent[this.targetC[0]+this.targetC[1]*64];
    while (!this.nodeParent == this.parent[this.nodeParent]){
      this.nodeParent = this.parent[this.nodeParent];
      insertstring this.path,0,#v(int(this.nodeParent/64));
      insertstring this.path,0,#v(this.nodeParent%64);
    }
    for (this.p = 0; this.p < sarraylen(this.path)/2; this.p++){
      this.pointX = strtofloat(#I(this.path,this.p*2)) - this.pOffset[0];
      this.pointY = strtofloat(#I(this.path,this.p*2+1)) - this.pOffset[1];
      this.dists = {this.pointX-x,y-this.pointY};
      movetoPoint();
    }
    this.dists = {this.targetC[0] - this.pOffset[0] - x,y - this.targetC[1] + this.pOffset[1]};
    movetoPoint();
    x = this.targetC[0] - this.pOffset[0];
    y = this.targetC[1] - this.pOffset[1];
    hideimg 400;
    setcharani idle,;
    message oh yeah!;
  }
  else if (onwall(this.targetC[0],this.targetC[1]) || this.noPath == 1){
    hideimg 300;
    message couldn't find path;
  }
  else {
    message #s(this.open);
    this.newNode = {9999,this.focusC[0]+this.focusC[1]*64};//score(make sure a score can get under it),x,y
    addAdj();
    if (sarraylen(this.open) <= 0)this.noPath = 1;
    hideimgs 300,300+sarraylen(this.open);
    for (this.i = 0; this.i < sarraylen(this.open); this.i++){
      this.nodePos = {strtofloat(#I(this.open,this.i))%64,int(strtofloat(#I(this.open,this.i))/64)};
      showimg 300+this.i,plant.png,this.nodePos[0],this.nodePos[1];
      getGScore();
      this.hScore = abs(this.nodePos[0]-this.targetC[0])+abs(this.nodePos[1]-this.targetC[1]);
      this.fScore = this.gScore + this.hScore;

      if (this.fScore < this.newNode[0]){
        this.newNode[0] = this.fScore;
        this.newNode[1] = this.nodePos[0] + this.nodePos[1]*64;
      }
    }
    addstring this.closed,#v(this.newNode[1]);
    deletestring this.open,lindexof(#v(this.newNode[1]),this.open);
    this.focusC[0] = this.newNode[1]%64;
    this.focusC[1] = int(this.newNode[1]/64);
    //showimg 300,plant.png,this.focusC[0],this.focusC[1];
    sleep 0.05;
    scanOpen();
  }
}

function addAdj(){
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < 4; this.i++){
    this.testC = {this.focusC[0]+vecx(this.i)*this.pSize[0],this.focusC[1]+vecy(this.i)*this.pSize[1]};

    this.check = this.testC[0]+this.testC[1]*64;
    checkBlock();
    if (this.wall == 0 && lindexof(#v(this.check),this.open) < 0 && lindexof(#v(this.check),this.closed) < 0){
      addstring this.open,#v(this.check);
      this.parent[this.testC[0]+this.testC[1]*64] = this.focusC[0]+this.focusC[1]*64;
    }
  }
}

function getGScore(){
  this.gScore = 0;
  this.nodeParent = this.parent[this.nodePos[0]+this.nodePos[1]*64];
  while (!this.nodeParent == this.parent[this.nodeParent]){
    this.dist = ((this.nodeParent%64-this.parent[this.nodeParent]%64)^2 + (int(this.nodeParent/64)-int(this.parent[this.nodeParent]/64))^2)^0.5;
    this.gScore += this.dist;
    this.nodeParent = this.parent[this.nodeParent];
  }
}

function checkBlock(){
  this.wall = 0;
  for (this.w = 0; this.w < this.pSize[0]*this.pSize[1]; this.w++)
    this.wall+= (onwall(this.testC[0]+(this.w%this.pSize[0]),this.testC[1]+int(this.w/this.pSize[0])));
}

function movetoPoint(){
  this.angle = getangle(this.dists[0],this.dists[1]);
  dir = getdir(this.dists[0],-this.dists[1]);
  this.dist = (this.dists[0]^2 + this.dists[1]^2)^0.5;
  for (this.d = 0; this.d < this.dist; this.d+=this.speed){
    x += cos(this.angle)*this.speed;
    y += sin(this.angle)*this.speed;
    sleep 0.05;
  }
}

// ===== 04_ultimatenpcpack/ultimatenpcpack1_graaldropboxdump/pathfinding__000__20_20.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: ultimatenpcpack1/graaldropboxdump/pathfinding.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC block.png 20 20
// image: block.png
// tile: 20,20
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 2214475eb4f2

NPC block.png 20 20
// NPC made by *Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setimgpart block.png,0,0,16,16;
  //Target
  this.tx = 34;
  this.ty = 20;
  //---------
  this.dCost = 1.4;//tile Distance cost diagonally
  this.startX = int(x);
  this.startY = int(y);
  this.cx = this.startX;
  this.cy = this.startY;

  this.oldSize = arraylen(this.open);
  findadjacentOpen();

  for (this.i=this.oldSize;this.i<this.adjC;this.i++){
    this.testx = this.open[this.i]%64;
    this.testy = int(this.open[this.i]/64);

  }
}

function findadjacentOpen(){
  this.adjC = 0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<9;this.i++){
    this.sx = this.cx-1+(this.i%3);
    this.sy = this.cy-1+int(this.i/3);
    if (!onwall(this.sx,this.sy)){
      addstring this.open,#v(this.sy*64+this.sx);
      this.adjC++;
    }
  }
}

function calcH(){
  this.h = abs(this.testx-this.tx)+abs(this.testy-this.ty);
}

function calcG(){
  this.maxG = min(abs(this.testx-this.startX),abs(this.testy-this.startY));
  this.g = this.maxG*this.dCost;
  this.g+= ((abs(this.testx-this.startX)+abs(this.testy-this.startY))-this.maxG);
}

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Save The Queen Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon5.gif",700,"Save The Queen: A sword that has been passed down through the royal knights for generations.","Swords/Save The Queen Sword";

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Split Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon6.gif",250,"Split Sword: A sword design from a far away kingdom. It can be considered a foreign Gladius.","Swords/Split Sword";

  if (!hasweapon(Swords/Dragons Scale Sword))callweapon this.i,setWeapons,"riley_exoticswordicon7.gif",1000,"Dragon's Scale: A sword made from a single dragon scale crafted over a period of 40 years time.","Swords/Dragons Scale Sword";
}

  this.rotation = (this.rotation + this.rotSpeed);
  this.realRadius = (this.baseRadius+sin(this.rotation)*this.radGrowth);

  this.imgIndex = 300;

    this.layerRadius = (this.realRadius+this.l*this.layerSpacing);

    for (this.s = 0; this.s < sarraylen(this.radiusLayer#v(this.l)); this.s++){
      this.spriteInd = strtofloat(#I(this.radiusLayer#v(this.l),this.s));
      this.spriteRot = this.layerRot+(this.s/sarraylen(this.radiusLayer#v(this.l)))*(pi*2);

      this.drawC = {
        this.focusC[0]+cos(this.spriteRot)*this.layerRadius-(this.sprites[this.spriteInd*4+2]/2),
        this.focusC[1]+sin(this.spriteRot)*this.layerRadius-(this.sprites[this.spriteInd*4+3]/2)
      };

      showimg this.imgIndex,#s(this.spriteSheet),this.drawC[0],this.drawC[1];

      this.imgIndex++;

    showimg this.imgIndex,test_circle-spacer.gif,this.focusC[0]-16,this.focusC[1]-16;

    changeimgvis this.imgIndex,4;
    this.imgIndex++;
  }

    hideimgs 300,this.imgIndex;
    for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
      callnpc this.n,translationComplete,;
    }
  }
  this.translationTime -= 0.05;

}

function initData(){
  for (this.l = 0; this.l < this.radiusLayers; this.l++){
    setstring this.radiusLayer#v(this.l),;
    for (this.d = 0; this.d < 2*pi*this.baseRadius*(this.l+1)*this.layerSpacing/1024; this.d++){//2*pi*r == perimiter length of the circle
      addstring this.radiusLayer#v(this.l),#v(int(random(0,arraylen(this.sprites)/4)));//define random sprite index
    }
  }
}

function draw_base(){
  disabledefmovement;
  //draw main image
  showimg 300,#s(this.img),this.ox,this.oy;
  changeimgpart 300,122,this.tab*240,400,240;
  changeimgvis 300,4;

  for (this.i=0;this.i<3;this.i++){
    showimg 301+this.i,#s(this.img),this.ox+50+(this.i*42),this.oy-22;
    changeimgpart 301+this.i,(!this.i==this.tab)*46,69+this.i*42,46,22;
    changeimgvis 301+this.i,5;
  }
  draw_main();
}

function draw_main(){
  hideimgs 308,310+this.itemsAllowed;//308,309:scroll up/down indication

  if (this.tab==0){//armour
    setstring this.categories,bow,bomb,block;
    get_categories();

    this.rowLength=2;
    this.tableHeight=4;
    this.items=this.weaponcount;
    this.itemsAllowed=8;

    this.draw_x=this.ox+285;
    this.draw_y=this.oy+51;
    draw_weapons();
  }
  else if (this.tab==1){//items
    setstring this.categories,bow,bomb;
    get_categories();

    this.rowLength=8;
    this.tableHeight=4;
    this.items=this.weaponcount;
    this.itemsAllowed=32;

    this.draw_x=this.ox+59;
    this.draw_y=this.oy+51;
    draw_weapons();
  }
  else {//stats
    this.rowLength=0;
    this.items=0;
    this.itemsAllowed=0;

    this.draw_x=this.ox+141;
    this.draw_y=this.oy+64;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<5;this.i++){
      showtext 310+this.i,this.draw_x,this.draw_y+this.i*25,arial,l,0#I(this.stats,this.i);
      changeimgzoom 310+this.i,.6;
      changeimgcolors 310+this.i,(168/255),(167/255),(121/255),;
      changeimgvis 310+this.i,5;
    }
  }
  draw_Scroller();
}

function get_categories(){//retrieves all weapons in the defined categories and place them in an array
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++)this.weapons[this.i]=-1;//reset the array
  this.weaponcount=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<weaponscount;this.i++){
    tokenize2 /_,#w(this.i);
    if (strcontains(#s(this.categories),#t(0))){
      this.weapons[this.weaponcount]=this.i;
      this.weaponcount++;
    }
  }
}

function draw_weapons(){//draw all weapons in the weapon array
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.itemsAllowed;this.i++){
    if (this.i>=this.weaponcount)this.i=this.itemsAllowed;
    else {
      showimg 310+this.i,#W(this.weapons[this.i+this.startIndex]),this.draw_x+(this.i%this.rowLength)*36,this.draw_y+int(this.i/this.rowLength)*36;
      changeimgvis 310+this.i,5;
    }
  }
}

function draw_Scroller(){
  if (this.startIndex>0){
    showimg 308,#s(this.img),this.ox+370,this.oy+72;
    changeimgpart 308,44,0,20,42;
    changeimgvis 308,5;
  }
  else hideimg 308;

  if (this.startIndex+this.itemsAllowed<this.items){
    showimg 309,#s(this.img),this.ox+370,this.oy+126;
    changeimgpart 309,64,0,20,42;
    changeimgvis 309,5;
  }
  else hideimg 309;
}

function close(){
  enabledefmovement;
  hideimgs 300,310+this.items;
}

function plot(){//find all accessible points
  this.loop = sarraylen(this.points);
  this.count++;
  if (this.count%5==0)sleep .05;//break up the loops
  for (this.p = this.cutoff;this.p<this.loop;this.p++){
    this.px = strtofloat(#I(this.points,this.p))%64;
    this.py = int(strtofloat(#I(this.points,this.p))/64);
    for (this.d=0;this.d<4;this.d++){
      this.cx = this.px+vecx(this.d)*2;
      this.cy = this.py+vecy(this.d)*2;
      if (!onwall(this.cx,this.cy) && lindexof(#v(this.cy*64+this.cx),this.points)<0){
        addstring this.points,#v(this.cy*64+this.cx);
        addstring this.pd,#v(this.count);
      }
    }
  }
  this.loop = this.cutoff;
  this.dist--;
  draw();
  if (this.dist<=0){
    this.selectpath = 1;
    timeout=0.05;
  }
  else plot();
}

function draw(){
  for (this.i=this.cutoff;this.i<sarraylen(this.points);this.i++){
    if (this.i==0)continue;
    showimg 300+this.i,place-numbers.gif,strtofloat(#I(this.points,this.i))%64,int(strtofloat(#I(this.points,this.i))/64);
    changeimgpart 300+this.i,(strtofloat(#I(this.pd,this.i))-1)*32,0,32,32;
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,0;
  }
}

function PC_Snap() {
  npcs[this.sel].x = int((npcs[this.sel].x + 1) / 2)*2 - 0.5;
  npcs[this.sel].y = int((npcs[this.sel].y + 1.5) / 2)*2 - 1;
}

function findPath(){//find a path to the destination
  this.mx = strtofloat(#I(this.path,0))%64;
  this.my = int(strtofloat(#I(this.path,0))/64);
  while (this.dist>0){
    this.tx = strtofloat(#I(this.tpath,this.count))%64;
    this.ty = int(strtofloat(#I(this.tpath,this.count))/64);
    this.min = this.dist;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
      this.nx = this.tx+vecx(this.i)*2;//check x
      this.ny = this.ty+vecy(this.i)*2;//check y

      this.tind = lindexof(#v(this.ny*64+this.nx),this.points);//temp index
      this.nd = strtofloat(#I(this.pd,this.tind));//new dist
      if ((this.nd<this.min && this.tind>=0) || this.nd==1){
        addstring this.tpath,#v(this.ny*64+this.nx);
        this.count++;
        this.dist--;
        this.i = 4;
      }
    }
  }
}

function followPath(){
  if (sarraylen(this.path)>1)triggeraction npcs[this.sel].x+1,npcs[this.sel].y+2,Gani,walk;
  this.mx = strtofloat(#I(this.path,0))%64;
  this.my = int(strtofloat(#I(this.path,0))/64);
  for (this.i=1;this.i<sarraylen(this.path);this.i++){
    this.ox = this.mx;//old x
    this.oy = this.my;//old y
    this.mx = strtofloat(#I(this.path,this.i))%64;
    this.my = int(strtofloat(#I(this.path,this.i))/64);

    if (this.ox==this.mx)npcs[this.sel].dir=(this.my-this.oy>0)?2:0;
    else npcs[this.sel].dir = (this.ox-this.mx>0)?1:3;

    for (this.m=0;this.m<2;this.m+=.4){
      npcs[this.sel].x+=vecx(npcs[this.sel].dir)*.4;
      npcs[this.sel].y+=vecy(npcs[this.sel].dir)*.4;
      showimg 298,zold_icon_arrow_02.png,npcs[this.sel].x+1,npcs[this.sel].y-1;
      sleep .05;
    }
  }
  triggeraction npcs[this.sel].x+1,npcs[this.sel].y+2,Gani,idle;
  PC_Snap();
}

//      JF Targeting
//
//          by Vangel (JF) to show Dyant
//          and others some basic NPC
//          Weapon coding techniques.

if (playertouchsme) {
  // give the player the weapon when they
  // touch it
  toweapons JF Targeting;
  // also refill their magic points
  playermp=100;
}
if (weaponfired) {
  // i'm gonna make an automatic targeting
  // system.  the little target will move around
  // the board controlled by the direction that
  // the player is facing.
  // the first thing to do is to activeate the target
  // if it's inactive.  if it's active (2nd time they
  // press the button) then we want to explode it.
  // if the target is active...
  if (this.targetactive==0) {
    // variables start as 0, so i know that
    // the first time this is ever called,
    // the weapon will be disactive
    // ie, this.targetactive will = 0
    // make sure that the player has
    // enough magic points to activate the
    // targeting system.
    if (playermp>=10) {
      // subtract some magic points so that
      // it costs something to use the weapon.
      playermp-=10;
      // activate the target
      this.targetactive=1;
      // set the starting x and y positions of
      // the target.
      this.x=playerx+.5;
      this.y=playery+1;
      // make the target appear
      showimg 0, jftarget.gif, this.x, this.y;
      // set the timeout so i can make the target
      // keep moving
      timeout=.05;
      // to see what happens next, find the
      // if (timeout) {
      // line and keep reading there.
    } // (this ends the if (playermp>5) section
  // else the weapon is active and this means
  // that this is the second time that the player
  // fired the weapon and the target is already out
  // there somewhere;
  } else {
    // deactivate the target
    this.targetactive==0;
    // put an explosion at the target location
    putexplosion 1, this.x, this.y;
    // hide the target
    hideimg 0;
  }  // end if (this.targetactive==0) ... else
} // end if (weaponfired)
// the (timeout) event is used to move the
// target around until it's time to explode it.
if (timeout) {
  //check to make sure the target is active
  if (this.targetactive==1) {
    // move the target depending on which
    // way the player is facing.
    if (playerdir==0) this.y--;  // up
    if (playerdir==1) this.x--;  // left
    if (playerdir==2) this.y++; // down
    if (playerdir==3) this.x++; // right
    // make sure that the target doesn't move
    // off the screen, instead, if you move the target
    // off one side, make it reappear on the other =)
    if (this.x<0) this.x=64;
    if (this.x>64) this.x=0;
    if (this.y<0) this.y=64;
    if (this.y>64) this.y=0;
    // move the target to its new location
    showimg 0, jftarget.gif, this.x, this.y;
    // to make sure that the target keeps moving,
    // we need to tell the timeout event how long
    // to wait until it fires again.  .05 is the smallest
    // amount of time that you can use in timeout=
    timeout=.05;
  }  // end if (this.targetactive==1)
} // end if (timeout)

if (playerenters) {
  showlocal;
  tankhearts1=40;
}
while (playerhearts>=0) {
  if (intank1) {
    if (keydown(0)) {
      if (!onwall(x+0.5,y-0.5)) {
        y-=0.5;
      }
      showimg turret,turretup.gif,x,y;
      this.tankdir1=0;
    }
    if (keydown(1)) {
      if (!onwall(x-0.5,y+0.5)) {
        x-=0.5;
      }
      showimg turret,turretleft.gif,x,y;
      this.tankdir1=1;
    }
    if (keydown(2)) {
      if (!onwall(x+0.5,y+2)) {
        y+=0.5;
      }
      showimg turret,turretdown.gif,x,y;
      this.tankdir1=2;
    }
    if (keydown(3)) {
      if (!onwall(x+2,y+0.5)) {
        x+=0.5;
      }
      showimg turret,turretright.gif,x,y;
      this.tankdir1=3;
    }
    if (keydown(5)) {
      shootfireblast abs(this.tankdir1);
      freezeplayer 0.3;
      hideplayer 0.3;
      sleep 0.3;
    }
    if (keydown(4)) {
      putexplosion 0,x-2,y-2;
      putexplosion 0,x+2,y-2;
      putexplosion 0,x+2,y+2;
      putexplosion 0,x-2,y+2;
      putexplosion 0,x,y-2;
      putexplosion 0,x-2,y;
      putexplosion 0,x,y+2;
      putexplosion 0,x+2,y;
      freezeplayer 0.5;
      hideplayer 0.5;
      sleep 0.5;
    }
    if (keydown(6)) {
      freezeplayer 0.25;
      hideplayer 0.25;
      sleep 0.25;
      putbomb 1,x,y;
    }
    if (exploded) {
      tankhearts1--;
    }
    if (tankhearts1<=0) {
      enableweapons;
      hidelocal;
      unset intank1;
      unset btank1;
      setlevel2 minigameshouse.nw,35.5,31.5;
    }
    freezeplayer 0.05;
    hideplayer 0.05;
    playerx=x-0.5;
    playery=y-1;
    playerhearts=playerfullhearts;
  }
  message #v(tankhearts1);
  sleep 0.05;
}

function checkKicking() {
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++) {
    dx = (players[i].x+0.75+this.dirgo[players[i].dir*2]*2)-x;
    dy = (players[i].y+1.4+this.dirgo[players[i].dir*2+1]*2)-y;
    if (abs(dx)<=2 && abs(dy)<=2 && strcontains(#m(i),hockshot)) {
      pdir = players[i].dir;
      dx = (players[i].x+0.75)-x;
      dy = (players[i].y+1.4)-y;
      see = (pdir==0? dy>0 : pdir==1? dx>0 : pdir==2? dy<0 : dx<0);
      if (see==true) {
        if (pdir==0) {
          this.movey -= 2;
          this.movex += dx;
        }
        if (pdir==1) {
          this.movex -= 2;
          this.movey += dy;
        }
        if (pdir==2) {
          this.movey += 2;
          this.movex += dx;
        }
        if (pdir==3) {
          this.movex += 2;
          this.movey += dy;
        }
        veclen = (this.movex^2+this.movey^2)^0.5;
        this.movex *= 2/veclen;
        this.movey *= 2/veclen;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

      set client.playgoal;
    }
    timeout = 5;
  }

  if (this.walkmode==1) { // RANDOM
    if (this.runcounter>0) {
      testx = newx + 1.5 + vecx(dir);
      testy = newy + 2 + vecy(dir);
      if (onwall(testx,testy)) {
        dir = (dir+2)%4;
        this.runcounter = int(random(0,60));
      } else {
        x = newx;
        y = newy;
      }

      this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
      dir = (dir+1+int(random(0,2))*2)%4;
    }
  } else if (this.walkmode==2) { // LEFTRIGHT
    if (dir!=1 && dir!=3) dir = 3;
    else {
      x = newx;
      y = newy;
      if ((dir==1 && x<=this.x1) || (dir==3 && x>=this.x2))
        dir = (dir+2)%4;
    }
  } else if (this.walkmode==3) { // UPDOWN
    if (dir!=0 && dir!=2) dir = 2;
    else {
      x = newx;
      y = newy;
      if ((dir==0 && y<=this.y1) || (dir==2 && y>=this.y2))
        dir = (dir+2)%4;
    }
  } else if (this.walkmode==4) { // RECTANGLE
    x = newx;
    y = newy;
    if ((dir==0 && y<=this.y1) || (dir==1 && x<=this.x1) ||
        (dir==2 && y>=this.y2) || (dir==3 && x>=this.x2))
      dir = (dir+3)%4;
  }
  if (this.walkmode>1 && this.runcounter<=0)
    this.runcounter = 20;
  message;
  timeout = 0.05;
}

// Hurting stuff
if (washit && this.mode!=1 && hearts>0) {
  dx = x-playerx;
  dy = y-playery;
  len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
  hurtdx = dx/len;
  hurtdy = dy/len;
  setcharani hurt,;
  hideimg 1;
  hearts -= playerswordpower/2;
}
if ((exploded || waspelt || wasshot) &&
    this.mode!=1 && hearts>0 && isleader) {
  hurtdx = -vecx(dir)*0.2;
  hurtdy = -vecy(dir)*0.2;
  setcharani hurt,;
  if (peltwithsign || peltwithvase || peltwithstone || peltwithnpc) hearts -= 1;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) hearts -= 1.5;
  else hearts -= 0.5;
}
if ((hurtdx!=0 || hurtdy!=0) && isleader && this.mode!=4) {
  this.hurtdx = hurtdx;
  this.hurtdy = hurtdy;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 4; // DYING
    message;
    setcharani dead,;
    timeout = 1.2;
  } else {
    this.mode = 1; // HURTED
    this.runcounter = 20;
    setcharani hurt,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
if (timeout && this.mode==1) { // HURTED
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>10) {
    testx = x + 1.5 + this.hurtdx*2;
    testy = y + 2 + this.hurtdy*2;
    if (!onwall(testx,testy)) {
      x += this.hurtdx;
      y += this.hurtdy;
    }
  }
  if (this.runcounter<=0) {
    if (swordpower>0) this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    else this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.runcounter = 100;
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==5) { // RESPAWN
  this.mode = 0;
  this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
  timeout  = 0.05;
  hearts = 99;
  setcharani idle,;
  this.walkmode = 1;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==4) { // DYING
  i = random(0,100);
  if (i<10) lay greenrupee;
  else if (i<15) lay bluerupee;
  else if (i<30) lay heart;
  this.mode = 5; // RESPAWN
  timeout = 5;
}

  this.raildirs = {1,3, 0,2, 2,3, 1,2, 0,3, 1,0};
  this.acc = 0.25;
  this.friction = 0.97;
  this.maxspeed = 2;

  if (this.on==false) {
    this.speed = 0;
    this.waypos = 0;
    searchforrails();
    if (this.on==true)
      this.waypos = 2;
  }

function searchforrails() {
  tx = playerx+1.5;
  ty = playery+2;
  this.outdir = -1;
  this.oldrailx = this.railx;
  this.oldraily = this.raily;

  pushdir = playerdir;
  if (!keydown(pushdir)) {
    if (keydown((pushdir+1)%4))
      pushdir = (pushdir+1)%4;
    if (keydown((pushdir-1)%4))
      pushdir = (pushdir-1)%4;
  }

  for (i=0; i<npcscount; i++) {
    nx = npcs[i].x;
    ny = npcs[i].y;
    indir = -1;
    outdir = -1;
    if (npcs[i].save[9]==1 && tx in |nx,nx+4> && ty in |ny,ny+4>) {
      type = npcs[i].save[0];
      d1 = this.raildirs[type*2];
      d2 = this.raildirs[type*2+1];
      oppdir = (playerdir+2)%4;

      if (d1==oppdir) {
        indir = d1;
        outdir = d2;
      } else if (d2==oppdir) {
        indir = d2;
        outdir = d1;
      }
    }
    if (outdir>=0) {
      if (this.outdir<0 || outdir==pushdir || (this.outdir!=pushdir &&
outdir==playerdir)) {
        this.railx = nx;
        this.raily = ny;
        this.indir = indir;
        this.outdir = outdir;
        if (outdir==pushdir)
          break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (this.outdir>=0) {
    if (this.waypos>0) {
      wayposset = false;
      if (this.indir in {0,2}) {
        playerx = this.railx+0.5;
        this.waypos -= abs(this.raily-this.oldraily);
        wayposset = true;
      }
      if (this.indir in {1,3}) {
        playery = this.raily;
        this.waypos -= abs(this.railx-this.oldrailx);
        wayposset = true;
      }
      if (wayposset==false) {
        if (this.waypos>=4)
          this.waypos -= 4;
        else
          this.waypos = 0;
      }
    }

    this.on = true;
    disabledefmovement;
    if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy))
      set disablebomymovement;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
function turnoff() {
  this.on = false;
  enabledefmovement;
  if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
    unset disablebomymovement;
    setani bomy_idle,;
  } else
    setani idle,;
  stopsound train.wav;
}
function setanimation() {
  if (strequals(#s(client.race),bomy)) {
    if (this.speed==0)
      setani bomy_draisine,;
    else
      setani bomy_draisine2,;
  } else {
    if (this.speed==0)
      setani draisine,;
    else
      setani draisine2,;
  }
}



if (timeout && this.on==true) {
  if (keydown(6))
    turnoff();
  else {
    freezeplayer 0.05;
    if (keydown(5)) {
      if (this.speedkeydown==false) {
        this.speed += this.acc;
        if (this.speed>this.maxspeed)
          this.speed = this.maxspeed;
        playlooped train.wav;
      }
      this.speedkeydown = true;
    } else {
      this.speedkeydown = false;
    }

    tox = this.railx+0.5+vecx(this.indir)*2;
    toy = this.raily+vecy(this.indir)*2;
    isstraight = (this.indir==(this.outdir+2)%4);
    if (isstraight==true) {
      tox += this.waypos * vecx(this.outdir);
      toy += this.waypos * vecy(this.outdir);
    } else {
      w = this.waypos/4*3.14/2;
      dside = 1-cos(w);
      dforward = sin(w);

      fdir = (this.indir+2)%4;
      tox += dforward*2*vecx(fdir);
      toy += dforward*2*vecy(fdir);

      tox += dside*2*vecx(this.outdir);
      toy += dside*2*vecy(this.outdir);
    }
    playerx = tox;
    playery = toy;

    if (!(playerx+1.5 in |this.railx,this.railx+4| && playery+2 in
|this.raily,this.raily+4|)
        || (isstraight==true && this.speed>0)) {
      this.on = false;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==false)
        turnoff();
    } else
      timeout = 0.05;

    if (this.on==true) {
      addspeed = this.speed;
      if (!(playerx+1.5,playery+2 in |4,60|) && addspeed>1)
        addspeed = 1;
      this.waypos += addspeed;
      if (this.waypos>=2) playerdir = this.outdir;
      this.speed *= this.friction;
      if (this.speed<0.05)
        this.speed = 0;
      if (this.speed==0)
        stopsound train.wav;
      setanimation();
    }
  }
}
if (playerenters && isweapon) {
  if (this.on==true) {
    if (playerx<-1) playerx = -1;
    if (playerx>62) playerx = 62;
    if (playery<-1.5) playery = -1.5;
    if (playery>61.5) playery = 61.5;
    // Wait 10 seconds till the rail npcs might appear
    for (this.i=0; this.i<10; this.i+=0.05) {
      this.on = false;
      this.waypos = 0;
      searchforrails();
      if (this.on==true) {
        this.waypos = 2;
        break;
      }
      sleep 0.05;
    }
    if (this.on==false)
      turnoff();
  }
}

if (timeout && (this.mode==0 || this.mode==2)) {
  // Look for players
  mindist = 1000;
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++)
      if (players[i].hearts>0) {
    dx = players[i].x - x;
    dy = players[i].y - y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) pdir=3; else pdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) pdir=2; else pdir=0;
    }
    if (pdir==dir) {
      dist = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
      if (dist<mindist) {
        cansee = 1;
        if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) k = int(abs(dx));
        else k = int(abs(dy));
        for (j=0; j<=k-2; j++)
          if (onwall(x+1.5+dx*j/k,y+2+dy*j/k)) cansee = 0;
        if (cansee!=0) {
          mindist = dist;
          aimplayer = i;
          this.aimx = players[i].x;
          this.aimy = players[i].y;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (mindist<=3) {
    this.runcounter = -1;
    this.mode = 3; // SLAYING
    setcharani sword,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  } else if (mindist<20) {
    if (this.mode!=2) message ;
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
  } else timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==3) { // SLAYING
  this.runcounter++;
  if (this.runcounter>4) {
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  message;
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==2) { // HUNTING
  setcharani walk,;
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>0 && aimplayer<playerscount && players[aimplayer].hearts>0) {
    // Get new direction
    dx = players[aimplayer].x-x;
    dy = players[aimplayer].y-y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) dir=3; else dir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) dir=2; else dir=0;
    }

    // Test if we can do a step
    dx = this.aimx-x;
    dy = this.aimy-y;
    if (abs(dx)<=1 && abs(dy)<=1) {
      this.aimx = players[aimplayer].x;;
      this.aimy = players[aimplayer].y;
      dx = this.aimx-x;
      dy = this.aimy-y;
    }
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) testdir=3; else testdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) testdir=2; else testdir=0;
    }
    len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
    addx = (dx/len)*this.huntspeed;
    addy = (dy/len)*this.huntspeed;
    testx = x + 1.5;
    testy = y + 2;
    if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy+addy)) {
      // Do a step
      x += addx;
      y += addy;
   } else if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy)) x += addx;
   else if (!onwall(testx,testy+addy)) y += addy;
  } else {
    this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.walkmode = 1; // RANDOM
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
    setcharani idle,;
    dir = (dir+2)%4;
    message;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}

  function movement() {

      hideimg 2;

    if(this.ang<0) this.ang+=6.284;
    elseif(this.ang>6.248) this.ang-=6.284;

    elseif (keydown(3)) this.ang+=0.2;

      this.dx+=this.accel*cos(this.ang);
      this.dy+=this.accel*sin(this.ang);
      mag=(this.dx^2+this.dy^2)^0.5;
      if(mag>this.maxspeed){
        this.dx*=this.maxspeed/mag;
        this.dy*=this.maxspeed/mag;
      }
      if (keydown(5)) {
        if (this.fullboost>0) {
          this.maxspeed=this.boost;
          this.fullboost-=1;
          setplayerprop #c,BOOST: #v(int(this.fullboost))%;
        }
      }
    }

      this.maxspeed=this.maxdef;
      if (this.fullboost<100) {
        this.fullboost+=0.5;
        setplayerprop #c,BOOST: #v(int(this.fullboost))%;
      }
    }
    if (keydown(2)) {
      this.dx-=this.deccel*this.dx/mag;
      this.dy-=this.deccel*this.dy/mag;
    }
  }

    }
  }
}
