//Also, take note of the editable variables under the function "DefineChar"
//
//"this.arrowpow" is the power of the arrows it uses (1=arrow, 2=fireball, 3=fireblast, 4=nuke
//"this.boompow" is the number of half hearts taken off the player when hit with the boomerang
//"this.shootdist" is how far away the baddy must be before it tries to use the bow
//"this.attackdist" is how close it must be before it'll swing its sword (to make it easier to hit with the sword, I'd suggest lowering this)
//"this.throwdist" is how clost it must be before it'll throw what its carrying (if carrying)
//"this.boomdist" is how far the boomerang will travel
//"this.usesdarts" enables the use of the darts in the baddy
//(if equal to 1, each time the baddy shoots, 1 dart will be subtracted from its total, when the total is 0, itll use the boomerang)
//"this.speed" is how fast the baddy moves
//"this.magspeed" is how fast magic moves
//"this.wepspeed" is how fast the boomerang moves
//"this.castdelay" is the amount of time the baddy speaks before deciding to cast magic (every 2.5 seconds the baddy chats)
//
//All distance related variables are measured in Graal-Tiles (1 tile is 16x16 pixels, fyi)
//
timereverywhere;
function DefineChar(){
  setcharprop #n,Ninji Power God;
  setcharprop #1,darkflame-sword.png;
  setcharprop #2,staff-shield.png;
  setcharprop #3,head.png;
  setcharprop #7,wbow2.gif;
  setcharprop #C0,black;
  setcharprop #C1,darkred;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,black;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  hearts=65;
  shieldpower=10;
  swordpower=15;
  ap=100;
  this.arrowpow=8;
  this.boompow=8;
  rupees=2896;
  darts=int(random(20,60));
  bombs=int(random(0,100));
  this.shootdist=20;
  this.attackdist=8;
  this.throwdist=20;
  this.boomdist=30;
  this.usesdarts=130;
  this.speed=.9;
  this.wepspeed=2.15;
  this.magspeed=.9;
  this.castdelay=5;
}
function Aim(){
  this.msgc++;
  if (this.msgc>=50){
    Chat();
    this.msgc=0;
  }
  if (this.distx<this.disty){
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x+3+this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x+=this.speed;
      dir=3;
    }
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x-this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x-=this.speed;
      dir=1;
    }
  }else{
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.speed)){
      y+=this.speed;
      dir=2;
    }
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.speed)){
      y-=this.speed;
      dir=0;
    }
  }
  ShootCheck();
}
function ArrowDodge(){
  if (arrowscount<1)return;
  else{
    for (i=0;i<arrowscount;i++){
      if (dir=(arrows[i].dir+2)%4&&
         ((dir==0&&arrows[i].y<y&&(y+1.5)-arrows[i].y<=6)||
          (dir==1&&arrows[i].x<x&&(x+1.5)-arrows[i].x<=6)||
          (dir==2&&arrows[i].y>y&&arrows[i].y-(y+1.5)<=6)||
          (dir==3&&arrows[i].x>x&&arrows[i].x-(x+1.5)<=6))){
        Teleport();
        Clothing();
      }
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  if (this.carry==1&&this.dist<=this.throwdist)Throw();
  else if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    message Ninjis hate weaklings;
    this.swing=1;
    sprite=9;
    sleep .05;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function BombCheck(){
  this.wait=0;
  if (bombscount>0){
    this.curdist=65;
    for (i=0;i<bombscount;i++){
      ConvertB();
      GetDist();
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.bindex=i;
      }
    }
    if (this.dist<this.shootdist){
      this.oldbcount=bombscount;
      SmartBomb();
      message;
      this.c=0;
    }else return;
  }else return;
}
function Boomerang(){
  this.boom=1;
  message Take this!;
  if (dir==0||dir==2)sprite=13;
  else sprite=6;
  BoomImg();
  sleep .2;
  GetBoomDist();
  ConvertPB();
  FlyCheck();
  this.flycount=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function BoomImg(){
  if (dir==0){
    this.flyx=x-.7;
    this.flyy=y+1.4;
  }else if (dir==1){
    this.flyx=x+1.9;
    this.flyy=y+1.5;
  }else if (dir==2){
    this.flyx=x+2.3;
    this.flyy=y+.7;
  }else if (dir==3){
    this.flyx=x-.2;
    this.flyy=y+1.5;
  }
  showimg 1,wboom1.gif,this.flyx,this.flyy;
}
function BoomReturn(){
  ConvertFly();
  GetDist();
  ConvertNPCB();
  FlyCheck();
  this.flyx+=this.flyaddx;
  this.flyy+=this.flyaddy;
  showimg 1,wboom.gif,this.flyx,this.flyy;
  if(testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy)>-1)hitplayer testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy),this.boompow,this.flyx,this.flyy;
  timeout=.05;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Throw();
  this.hit=1;
  while(this.hit==1&&i<7){
    MoveBoom();
    i++;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+2.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+2.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x-1.5,y-.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  this.hit=0;
  i=0;
  this.swing=0;
  this.cast=0;
  this.magic=0;
  this.shield=0;
  this.checkbomb=0;
  if (hearts>0)CounterMagic();
  timeout=.05;
}
function Catch(){
  message You throw like a newbie!;
  this.msgc=0;
  this.carry=1;
  sprite=24;
  if (peltwithbush) carryobject bush;
  else if (peltwithsign) carryobject sign;
  else if (peltwithvase) carryobject vase;
  else if (peltwithstone) carryobject stone;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) carryobject blackstone;
  else if (!peltwithnpc){
    i=bombscount-1;
    if (bombs[i].power==1) carryobject bomb;
    else if (bombs[i].power==2) carryobject superbomb;
    else if (bombs[i].power==3) carryobject joltbomb;
    removebomb i;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function Chat(){
  if (this.magdelay<this.castdelay){
    this.message=int(random(0,5));
    if (this.message==0)message Runaway!;
    else if (this.message==1) message Come here and fight like a ninji!;
    else if (this.message==2) message You're no chance against me...;
    else if (this.message==3) message Even a newbie ninji can beat you!;
    else if (this.message==4) message Tsk, tsk, tsk...;
    this.magdelay++;
  }else{
    this.magdelay=0;
    CounterMagic();
  }
}
function Clothing(){
  setcharprop #C0,black;
  setcharprop #C1,darkred;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,black;
  setcharprop #C4,black;}
function ConvertA(){
  this.tox=arrows[i].x;
  this.toy=arrows[i].y;
}
function ConvertB(){
  this.tox=bombs[i].x;
  this.toy=bombs[i].y;
}
function ConvertBi(){
  this.tox=bombs[this.bindex].x;
  this.toy=bombs[this.bindex].y;
}
function ConvertFly(){
  this.toy=this.flyy;
  this.tox=this.flyx;
}
function ConvertNPCB(){
  this.toflyx=x;
  this.toflyy=y;
}
function ConvertP(){
  this.tox=playerx;
  this.toy=playery;
}
function ConvertPB(){
  this.toflyx=playerx;
  this.toflyy=playery;
}
function CounterMagic(){
  Clothing();
  Throw();
  sprite=24;
  dir=2;
  message Ninji Magic Shield;
  this.shield=1;
  this.c=0;
  this.radius=4;
  this.angle=3.14/2;
  while (this.c<100){
    if (this.c==50){
      if (hearts<=2)this.magic=1;
      else this.magic=int(random(1,5));
    }
    if (this.magic!=0){
      if (this.magic==1)Drain();
      if (this.magic==2)Freeze();
      if (this.magic==3)Flame();
      if (this.magic==4)Jolt();
    }
    MoveBoom();
    MagicShield();
    if (this.magic!=3)sleep .05;
    else sleep .1;
    this.c++;
  }
  if (this.c>=100){
    this.c=0;
    hideimg 2;
    hideimg 3;
    hideimg 4;
    sprite=0;
    this.shield=0;
    this.magic=0;
    this.cast=0;
    this.p=0;
    this.magdelay=0;
    Chat();
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function Direction(){
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.toy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.toy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.tox<x)dir=1;
    if (this.tox>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function Drain(){
  ConvertP();
  GetMagDist();
  Direction();
  message Life Drain!;
  if (this.cast!=1){
    if (dir==0||dir==2)sprite=13;
    else sprite=6;
    MagImg();
    showimg 3,drainm.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    sleep .2;
    this.cast=1;
  }else if (this.cast==1){
    sprite=24;
    ConvertP();
    GetMagDist();
    MagMoveCheck();
    showimg 4,drainf.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    MagMove();
    showimg 3,drainm.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    for (i=0;i<playerscount;i++){
      if (players[i].id>-1&&abs(players[i].x-this.magx)<=2&&abs(players[i].y-this.magy)<=2){
        hitplayer i,swordpower*2,this.magx,this.magy;
        hearts+=swordpower;
        hideimg 3;
        hideimg 4;
        this.cast=0;
        this.c=100;
      }
    }
  }
}
function DropInv(){
  while(rupees>=100){
    lay goldrupee;
    rupees-=100;
  }
  while(rupees>=30){
    lay redrupee;
    rupees-=30;
  }
  while(rupees>=5){
    lay bluerupee;
    rupees-=5;
  }
  while(rupees>0){
    lay greenrupee;
    rupees-=1;
  }
  while(darts>0){
    lay darts;
    darts-=5;
  }
  while(bombs>0){
    lay bombs;
    bombs-=5;
  }
}
function ExploMove(){
  sprite=11;
  if (dir==0){
    this.e1y-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2x+=.4;
    this.e2y-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3x-=.4;
    this.e3y-=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (dir==1){
    this.e1x-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2y+=.4;
    this.e2x-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3y-=.4;
    this.e3x-=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (dir==2){
    this.e1y+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2x-=.4;
    this.e2y+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3x+=.4;
    this.e3y+=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (dir==3){
    this.e1x+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2y-=.4;
    this.e2x+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3y+=.4;
    this.e3x+=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (this.e1x<=0||this.e1x>=64||this.e1y<=0||this.e1y>=64){
    this.cast=0;
    this.c=100;
  }
  putexplosion 1,this.e1x,this.e1y;
  putexplosion 1,this.e2x,this.e2y;
  putexplosion 1,this.e3x,this.e3y;
}
function Flame(){
  message Ninji Fire Sword Attack!;
  if (this.p!=1){
    ConvertP();
    GetDist();
    Direction();
    if (dir==0){
      this.e1x=x+1.5;
      this.e1y=y-1;
      this.e2x=x+1.5;
      this.e2y=y-1;
      this.e3x=x+1.5;
      this.e3y=y-1;
    }
    if (dir==1){
      this.e1x=x-1;
      this.e1y=y+1.5;
      this.e2x=x-1;
      this.e2y=y+1.5;
      this.e3x=x-1;
      this.e3y=y+1.5;
    }
    if (dir==2){
      this.e1x=x+1.5;
      this.e1y=y+4;
      this.e2x=x+1.5;
      this.e2y=y+4;
      this.e3x=x+1.5;
      this.e3y=y+4;
    }
    if (dir==3){
      this.e1x=x+4;
      this.e1y=y+1.5;
      this.e2x=x+4;
      this.e2y=y+1.5;
      this.e3x=x+4;
      this.e3y=y+1.5;
    }
    this.p=1;
  }
  ExploMove();
}
function FlyCheck(){
  if (this.distx==0){
    if (this.flyy>this.toflyy)this.flyaddy=-this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddy=this.wepspeed;
  }else if (this.disty==0){
    if (this.flyx>this.toflyx)this.flyaddx=-this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddx=this.wepspeed;
  }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    if (this.flyx>this.toflyx)this.flyaddx=-this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddx=this.wepspeed;
    if (this.flyy>this.toflyy)this.flyaddy=-this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.flyaddy=this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.distx<this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    if (this.flyy<this.toflyy)this.flyaddy=this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddy=-this.wepspeed;
    if (this.flyx<this.toflyx)this.flyaddx=this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.flyaddx=-this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Freeze(){
  ConvertP();
  GetDist();
  Direction();
  message Ninji Freeze Attack!;
  if (this.cast!=1){
    if (dir==0||dir==2)sprite=13;
    else sprite=6;
    MagImg();
    showimg 3,freezem.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    sleep .2;
    this.cast=1;
  }else if (this.cast==1){
    ConvertP();
    GetMagDist();
    MagMoveCheck();
    showimg 4,freezef.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    MagMove();
    showimg 3,freezem.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    for (i=0;i<playerscount;i++){
      if (players[i].id>-1&&abs(players[i].x-this.magx)<=2&&abs(players[i].y-this.magy)<=2){
        this.tox=x;
        this.toy=y;
        PreOmni();
        PreTel();
        sleep .25;
        x=playerx+3;
        y=playery;
        dir=1;
        sleep .25;
        Clothing();
        message Omni-Slash!;
        OmniSlash();
        x=playerx;
        y=playery-3;
        OmniSlash();
        playerhearts--;
        x=playerx-3;
        y=playery;
        OmniSlash();
        playerhearts--;
        x=playerx;
        y=playery+3;
        OmniSlash();
        playerhearts--;
        PreTel();
        sleep .25;
        x=this.tox;
        y=this.toy;
        sleep .25;
        Clothing();
        Chat();
        this.cast=0;
        this.c=100;
      }
    }
  }
}
function GetBoomDist(){
  this.distx=abs(this.tox-this.flyx);
  this.disty=abs(this.toy-this.flyy);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function GetDist(){
  this.distx=abs(this.tox-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.toy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function GetMagDist(){
  this.distx=abs(this.tox-this.magx);
  this.disty=abs(this.toy-this.magy);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function ItemDrop(){
  i = random(0,100);
  if (i<10) lay greenrupee;
  else if (i<15) lay bluerupee;
  else if (i<30) lay heart;
}
function Jolt(){
  message Electric Spiral!;
  if (this.p!=1){
    this.angle=3.14/2;
    this.radius=4;
    this.p=1;
  }else{
    JoltMove();
  }
}
function JoltMove(){
  this.e1x=x+1.5+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
  this.e1y=y+1.5+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
  this.angle+=.314;
  this.radius+=.2;
  putexplosion2 3,1,this.e1x,this.e1y;
}
function MagicShield(){
  this.imgx=x-1.5;
  this.imgy=y-1.5;
  showimg 2,magishield.png,this.imgx,this.imgy;
  changeimgvis 2,0;
  for (i=0;i<exploscount;i++){
    if (explos[i].x>this.imgx-1&&explos[i].x<this.imgx+6&&explos[i].y>this.imgy-1&&explos[i].y<this.imgy+6)removeexplo i;
  }
  for (i=0;i<bombscount;i++){
    if (bombs[i].x>this.imgx-1&&bombs[i].x<this.imgx+6&&bombs[i].y>this.imgy-1&&bombs[i].y<this.imgy+6)explodebomb i;
  }
  for (i=0;i<arrowscount;i++){
    if (arrows[i].x>this.imgx-1&&arrows[i].x<this.imgx+6&&arrows[i].y>this.imgy-1&&arrows[i].y<this.imgy+6){
      if (arrows[i].type==0||arrows[i].type==1)removearrow i;
      else reflectarrow i;
    }
  }
}
function MagImg(){
  if (dir==0){
    this.magx=x-.7;
    this.magy=y+1.4;
  }
  if (dir==1){
    this.magx=x+1.9;
    this.magy=y+1.5;
  }
  if (dir==2){
    this.magx=x+2.3;
    this.magy=y+.7;
  }
  if (dir==3){
    this.magx=x-.2;
    this.magy=y+1.5;
  }
}
function MagMove(){
    this.magx+=this.addx;
    this.magy+=this.addy;
}
function MagMoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx==0){
    if (this.magy>this.toy)this.addy=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addy=this.magspeed;
  }else if (this.disty==0){
    if (this.magx>this.tox)this.addx=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addx=this.magspeed;
  }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    if (this.magx>this.tox)this.addx=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addx=this.magspeed;
    if (this.magy>this.toy)this.addy=-this.magspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.addy=this.magspeed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.distx<this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    if (this.magy>this.toy)this.addy=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addy=this.magspeed;
    if (this.magx>this.tox)this.addx=-this.magspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.addx=this.magspeed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function MoveBoom(){
  if (this.boom==1){
    if (this.flycount<this.boomdist){
      this.flycount++;
      this.flyx+=this.flyaddx;
      this.flyy+=this.flyaddy;
      showimg 1,wboom.gif,this.flyx,this.flyy;
      if(testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy)>-1)hitplayer testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy),this.boompow,this.flyx,this.flyy;
    }else{
      BoomReturn();
      if (this.dist<=2){
        hideimg 1;
        this.flycounter=0;
        this.boom=0;
      }
    }
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  if (y<this.toy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.toy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.tox&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.tox&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function OmniSlash(){
  sprite=9;
  while (sprite<13){
    playerx=this.px;
    playery=this.py;
    sprite++;
    MoveBoom();
    sleep .05;
  }
  if (dir<3)dir++;
  else dir=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function PreOmni(){
  this.tox=x;
  this.toy=y;
  showimg 3,wiceblock.gif,playerx,playery;
  this.px=playerx;
  this.py=playery;
  freezeplayer 2;
  hideimg 4;
  hideimg 2;
  timeout=.05;
}
function PreTel(){
  message Too slow!;
  setcharprop #C0,transparent;
  setcharprop #C1,transparent;
  setcharprop #C2,transparent;
  setcharprop #C3,transparent;
  setcharprop #C4,transparent;
  sprite=24;
}
function ShootBow(){
  sprite=33;
  if (this.arrowpow==1)shootarrow dir;
  if (this.arrowpow==2)shootfireball dir;
  if (this.arrowpow==3)shootfireblast dir;
  if (this.arrowpow==4)shootnuke dir;
  sleep .1;
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function ShootCheck(){
  if (this.usesdarts==1&&darts<1&&this.boom!=1){
    ConvertP();
    GetDist();
    if (abs(this.distx-this.disty)<=4){
      Direction();
      Boomerang();
    }
  }
  if((x-playerx<1&&playerx-x<1)||(y-playery<1&&playery-y<1)){
    if ((this.usesdarts==1&&darts>0)||this.usesdarts!=1){
      ConvertP();
      GetDist();
      Direction();
      message Take this!;
      sprite=33;
      while (this.scc<.4){
        sleep .05;
        ArrowDodge();
        this.scc+=.05;
      }
      if (this.scc>=.4){
        if (this.usesdarts==1)darts--;
        ShootBow();
        this.scc=0;
      }
    }else if (this.usesdarts==1&&darts<=0&&this.boom!=1){
      ConvertP();
      GetDist();
      Direction();
      Boomerang();
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SmartBomb(){
  if (bombs[this.bindex].time<2||this.carry==1){
    if (bombs[this.bindex].power==1||bombs[this.bindex].power==3){
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x<x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)+3;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x>x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)-3;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y<y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)+4;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y>y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)-4;
    }else if (bombs[this.bindex].power==2){
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x<x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)+7;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x>x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)-7;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y<y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)+8;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y>y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)-8;
    }
    GetDist();
    MoveCheck();
    while (this.dist>2&&bombs[this.bindex].time>0&&bombscount>0&&this.wait!=1){
      if (this.oldbcount!=bombscount){
        ConvertP();
        BombCheck();
      }
      SpriteAssign();
      Direction();
      Movement();
      if (this.hit!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
        if (washit){
          hurtdx=x;
          hurtdy=y;
          hearts-=playerswordpower;
        }
        if (exploded)hearts--;
        if (waspelt)hearts--;
        if (wasshot)hearts--;
        Throw();
        sprite=39;
        BounceBack();
        timeout=.05;
      }
      MoveBoom();
      ArrowDodge();
      Clothing();
      sleep .05;
      GetDist();
    }
    while (bombs[this.bindex].time>.1&&bombscount>0){
      this.wait=1;
      Wait();
      sleep .05;
      if (this.oldbcount!=bombscount) BombCheck();
    }
    while(bombs[this.bindex].time<=.1&&this.c<22){
      this.c++;
      Wait();
      sleep .05;
    }
  }else if (this.carry==0||bombs[this.bindex].time>=2){
    MoveCheck();
    while (abs(bombs[this.bindex].x-x)>2&&abs(bombs[this.bindex].y-y)>2){
      if (bombscount==0) return;
      if (this.oldbcount!=bombscount) BombCheck();
      SpriteAssign();
      Direction();
      Movement();
      if (this.hit!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
        if (washit){
          hurtdx=x;
          hurtdy=y;
          hearts-=playerswordpower;
        }
        if (exploded)hearts--;
        if (waspelt)hearts--;
        if (wasshot)hearts--;
        Throw();
        sprite=39;
        BounceBack();
        timeout=.05;
      }
      MoveBoom();
      ArrowDodge();
      Clothing();
      sleep .05;
      ConvertBi();
      GetDist();
    }
    if (abs(bombs[this.bindex].x-x)<=2&&abs(bombs[this.bindex].y-y)<=2){
      message Impossible!!!;
      sprite=23;
      sleep .1;
      sprite=24;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].power==1) carryobject bomb;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].power==2) carryobject superbomb;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].power==3) carryobject joltbomb;
      this.carry=1;
      removebomb this.bindex;
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  message Impossible!!!;
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpriteAssign(){
  if (this.carry!=1) sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  else if (this.carry==1){
    if (sprite<32)sprite++;
    else sprite=25;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else{
    sprite=0;
    this.dist+=1;
    this.swing=0;
    Chat();
  }
}
function Teleport(){
  this.telx=x;
  this.tely=y;
  PreTel();
  sleep .1;
  if (dir==0||dir==2){
    if (playerx>x)x-=3;
    else x+=3;
  }
  if (dir==1||dir==3){
    if (playery>y)y-=4;
    else y+=4;
  }
  while (this.c<.3){
    sleep .05;
    this.c+=.05;
    MoveBoom();
  }
  this.c=0;
  this.swing=0;
  this.scc=0;
  this.checkbomb=0;
  x=this.telx;
  y=this.tely;
  if (this.carry!=1)sprite=0;
  else if (this.carry==1)sprite=24;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Throw(){
  throwcarry;
  this.carry=0;
}
function Wait(){
  if (this.shield==1){
    this.wait=0;
    timeout=.05;
  }else{
    message .........;
    if (this.carry!=1){
      sprite=0;
      ShootCheck();
    }else sprite=24;
    if (this.hit!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
      if (washit){
        hurtdx=x;
        hurtdy=y;
        hearts-=playerswordpower;
      }
      if (exploded)hearts--;
      if (waspelt)hearts--;
      if (wasshot)hearts--;
      Throw();
      sprite=39;
      BounceBack();
      timeout=.05;
    }
    ArrowDodge();
    Clothing();
    ConvertP();
    GetDist();
    Direction();
    AttackCheck();
    MoveBoom();
  }
}
if (playerenters||wasthrown||created){
  showcharacter;
  DefineChar();
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;
  this.curdist=65;
  timeout=2;
  hideimg 1;
  hideimg 2;
  hideimg 3;
  hideimg 4;
}
if (timeout&&isleader&&hearts>0){
  ConvertP();
  this.msgc++;
  if (this.msgc>=50){
    Chat();
    this.msgc=0;
  }
  if (arrowscount>0)ArrowDodge();
  if (this.boom==1)MoveBoom();
  else if (this.boom!=1)hideimg 1;
  if (this.swing==1&&this.hit!=1)SwordAttack();
  else if (this.hit!=1&&this.swing!=1){
    if (bombscount>0)BombCheck();
    ConvertP();
    SpriteAssign();
    GetDist();
    if (this.dist<=this.shootdist||(this.carry==1||this.boom==1)){
      Direction();
      MoveCheck();
      Movement();
      AttackCheck();
    }else if (this.dist>this.shootdist&&this.carry!=1)Aim();
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
if (this.hit!=1&&this.shield!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
  if (washit){
    hurtdx=x;
    hurtdy=y;
    hearts-=playerswordpower;
  }
  if (exploded)hearts--;
  if (waspelt)hearts--;
  if (wasshot)hearts--;
  Throw();
  sprite=39;
  BounceBack();
  timeout=.05;
}
if (waspelt&&this.carry!=1&&this.shield!=1) Catch();
if (hearts>0&&playertouchsme) hurt swordpower;
if (hurtdx!=0||hurtdy!=0){
  hurtdx=0;
  hurtdy=0;
}
if (timeout&&hearts<=0&&isleader){
  Clothing();
  hideimg 1;
  hideimg 2;
  hideimg 3;
  hideimg 4;
  SpinMove();
  sprite=40;
  DropInv();
  message;
}

    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,mysprite*192,48,64;
  } else if (mydir==1) {
    x = realx-1.5;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,mysprite*192+64,96,64;
  } else if (mydir==2) {
    x = realx;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,48,mysprite*192,48,64;
  } else if (mydir==3) {
    x = realx-1.5;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,mysprite*192+128,96,64;
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

NPC - 0 0

  setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,64,96,64;
}
if (playertouchsme) {
  if (playermode in {0,3}) { // NORMAL/PUSHING
    playermode = 9; // RIDING
    setstring horseimg,ride.gif;
    setani ridestill,#s(horseimg);
    playerhorsebushes = 0;
    playerhorsebombs = 0;
    playeranicounter = 0;
    destroy;
  }
}

// Horse running stuff
if (created) {
  save[0] = 1; // dir
  save[1] = x*2; // realx
  save[2] = y*2; // realy
}
if (playerenters) {
  dirgo = {0,-1,-1,0,0,1,1,0};
  timeout = 5; // start running after 5 seconds
  this.speed = 0.5;
  this.runcounter = int(random(10,25));
}
if (timeout) {
  mydir = save[0];
  realx = save[1]/2;
  realy = save[2]/2;

  newx = realx + dirgo[mydir*2] * this.speed;
  newy = realy + dirgo[mydir*2+1] * this.speed;
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>0) {
    testx = newx + 1.5 + dirgo[mydir*2];
    testy = newy + 2+ dirgo[mydir*2+1];
    if (onwall(testx,testy) || onwater(testx,testy)) {
      mydir = (mydir+2)%4;
      this.runcounter = int(random(0,30));
    } else {
      realx = newx;
      realy = newy;
    }
  } else {
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,25));
    mydir = (mydir+1+int(random(0,2))*2)%4;
  }

  save[0] = mydir;
  save[1] = realx*2;
  save[2] = realy*2;

  mysprite = 1+int((this.runcounter/2)%2);
  if (this.runcounter%10==0) play horse2.wav;
  y = realy-1;
  if (mydir==0) {
    x = realx;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,mysprite*192,48,64;
  } else if (mydir==1) {
    x = realx-1.5;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,mysprite*192+64,96,64;
  } else if (mydir==2) {
    x = realx;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,48,mysprite*192,48,64;
  } else if (mydir==3) {
    x = realx-1.5;
    setgifpart kubol_horse.png,0,mysprite*192+128,96,64;
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

// ===== 04_ultimatenpcpack/ultimatenpcpack1_nwscripts_weapons/crossbow__000__5_14.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: ultimatenpcpack1/nwscripts/weapons/_crossbow.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC crossbow_icon.png 5 14
// image: crossbow_icon.png
// tile: 5,14
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 4764a5e54137

NPC crossbow_icon.png 5 14
// Project: NewWorld
// Title: CrossBow
// Author: Ace2896
// Requested By: None
// GIFs: New_Gut
// 6-26-2K - Ace2896
// Started work on the corssbow.
// Pretty much done, I'll finish it once NG has the gfx for me.
//
// 6-28-2K - Ace2896
// Tweaked it, scripted, finished.
//
// 6-29-2K - Ace2896
// Added the setbow thing so the bow won't show up whent he crossbow is used
// I also commented my script (which I forgot to do earlier)
// as well as made the defualt arrow speed faster.
//
// 6-30-2K - Ace2896
// Adjusted the reload time, and fixed a setbow problem for when firedwithS
//
// 7-2-2K - Ace2896
// Fixed the bug Enix mentioned,
// changed "this.iLoaded" to a string like Bruges suggested
// Removed all sleep commands (so arrow travel while shooting/reloading) is smooth
// changed the way the bow image is hiden after firing/reloading
//
//This part initalizes all the arrays
//and sets up some constants.
if (this.init!=1){
  this.cMaxArrow=10;  //the max amount of arrows on screen at one time
  this.cArrowLife=10;  //max amount of seconds an arrow can be on screen
  this.cArrowSpeed=1.5;  //speed at which an arrow travels
  this.cArrowPow=35/25;  //amount of hp to take off
  setarray this.nArrowX,this.cMaxArrow+1;  //array for the arrows' x value
  setarray this.nArrowY,this.cMaxArrow+1;  //array for the arrows' y value
  setarray this.iArrowDir,this.cMaxArrow+1;  //array for an arrows direction
  setarray this.iArrowTime,this.cMaxArrow+1;  //array to keep track of how long an arrow has been "alive"
//the next array takes some explaining.  I didn't want an arrow to disapear the second it hit a wall
//so if i set the arrowtime to life*15, the arrow would always be at life*15,
//so with arrowpause, if it's equal to 1, then the time wont be set to life*15
//therefore causing the arrow to pause for a little bit before destroying itself.
//if arrowpause is greater than 1, that means the arrow hasn't been shot yet.
  setarray this.iArrowPause,this.cMaxArrow+1;
  this.init=1;
}
//This puts the weapon in the player's weapon list.
if (playertouchsme) {
  toweapons Bows/Crossbow;
  hidelocal;
  timeout=.05;
}
//this is what to do when the weapon is fired with "d"
//note the crossbow must be "loaded" for this to work.
if (weaponfired&&strtofloat(#s(this.iLoaded))==1&&!firedwithS&&this.iArrowOut<this.cMaxArrow){
  playersprite=33;  //sets the bow sprite
  setbow blankimage.png;  //gives the player a blank bow
  this.BowOut=1;  //this says the player's bow image is visible
  freezeplayer .5;  //freezes the player
  setstring this.iLoaded,0;  //says the bow is no longer loaded
  this.iArrowPause[this.iArrowOut]=2;
  if (playerdir==0){  //this is what to do if the player is facing up
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx-.3,playery-1.2;  //the crossbow image
    changeimgpart 62,0,32,32,32;  //changes image to show the correct part
    this.nArrowX[this.iArrowOut]=playerx+.4;  //sets the x value of the arrow
    this.nArrowY[this.iArrowOut]=playery-1;  //sets the y value of the arrow
  }
//the following is the same as above, but for the other 3 directions
  if (playerdir==1){
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx-1,playery;
    changeimgpart 62,32,32,32,32;
    this.nArrowX[this.iArrowOut]=playerx-1.6;
    this.nArrowY[this.iArrowOut]=playery+.8;
  }
  if (playerdir==2){
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx-.3,playery+.5;
    changeimgpart 62,64,32,32,32;
    this.nArrowX[this.iArrowOut]=playerx+.5;
    this.nArrowY[this.iArrowOut]=playery;
  }
  if (playerdir==3){
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx+2,playery;
    changeimgpart 62,96,32,32,32;
    this.nArrowX[this.iArrowOut]=playerx+2.6;
    this.nArrowY[this.iArrowOut]=playery+.8;
  }
  this.iArrowDir[this.iArrowOut]=playerdir;  //sets the arrow's direction
  this.iArrowOut++;  //adds one to the count of arrows that are out
  timeout=.05;  //initializes the timeout
}
//what to do every timeout
if (timeout&&(this.iArrowOut>0||this.iLoading>0||this.BowOut>0)){
  if (this.BowOut>=1){  //if the player's bow image is visible
    this.BowOut++;  //count up so it can be hidden after the correct time
    if (this.BowOut>=12){
      this.BowOut=0;
      hideimg 62;  //hides the bow image
    }
  }
  if (this.iLoading>=1){  //what to do if the player was loading the bow
    this.iLoading++;  //count up
    if (this.iLoading>=6){  //when to change the bow image (to show its loaded)
      this.iLoading=0;  //now that its loading, this.iLoading is 0
      if (playerdir==0)changeimgpart 62,0,32,32,32;  //changes the images appropriately
      if (playerdir==1)changeimgpart 62,32,32,32,32;
      if (playerdir==2)changeimgpart 62,64,32,32,32;
      if (playerdir==3)changeimgpart 62,96,32,32,32;
    }
  }
  for (this.iArrow=0;this.iArrow<this.iArrowOut;this.iArrow++){  //this for loop monitors all the arrows
    if (this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]>1){  //what to do if the arrow isn't shot yet
      this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]++;  //add to count
      if (this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]>=7){  //what to do if the arrow is shot
        this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]=0;  //reset to 0
        if (playerdir==0)changeimgpart 62,0,0,32,32;  //changes the bow image
        if (playerdir==1)changeimgpart 62,32,0,32,32;
        if (playerdir==2)changeimgpart 62,64,0,32,32;
        if (playerdir==3)changeimgpart 62,96,0,32,32;
      }
    }
    if (this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]==0){  //what to do if the arrow was shot
      if (this.iArrowDir[this.iArrow]==0){  //what to do if the arrow travels up
        if (!onwall(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed)){  //if the arrow isn't going to hit a wall
          this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]-=this.cArrowSpeed;  //this will move it
        }else if (testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed)>=0||  //but if it did hit a wall
                  testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed)>0){  //this checks to see if the wall was a npc or player
          hitplayer testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];  //hits the player if there was one
          hitnpc testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];  //hits the npc if there was one
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;  //removes the arrow
        }else{  //if the arrow did hit a wall, and hasnt been paused yet
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*15;  //changes the arrow's life
          this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]=1;  //"pauses" the arrow
        }
        showimg this.iArrow,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];  //sprites for the actual arrow
        changeimgpart this.iArrow,128,0,8,30;  //the image part of the arrow
      }
//below is the same as above but for the other 3 directions
      if (this.iArrowDir[this.iArrow]==1){
        if (!onwall(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])){
          this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]-=this.cArrowSpeed;
        }else if (testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])>=0||
                  testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])>0){
          hitplayer testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
          hitnpc testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]-this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;
        }else{
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*15;
          this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]=1;
        }
        showimg this.iArrow,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
        changeimgpart this.iArrow,34,64,30,8;
      }
      if (this.iArrowDir[this.iArrow]==2){
        if (!onwall(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed)){
          this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]+=this.cArrowSpeed;
        }else if (testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed)>=0||
                  testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed)>0){
          hitplayer testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
          hitnpc testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;
        }else{
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*15;
          this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]=1;
        }
        showimg this.iArrow,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
        changeimgpart this.iArrow,135,0,8,30;
      }
      if (this.iArrowDir[this.iArrow]==3){
        if (!onwall(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])){
          this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]+=this.cArrowSpeed;
        }else if (testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])>=0||
                  testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])>0){
          hitplayer testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
          hitnpc testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]+this.cArrowSpeed,this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;
        }else{
          this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*15;
          this.iArrowPause[this.iArrow]=1;
        }
        showimg this.iArrow,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
        changeimgpart this.iArrow,96,64,30,8;
      }
    }
    this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]++;  //adds to the var keeping track of how long the arrow has been out
    if (testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])>0){  //player hit detection script
      hitplayer testplayer(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
      this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;
    }
    if (testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow])>=0){  //npc hit detection script
      hitnpc testnpc(this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]),this.cArrowPow,this.nArrowX[this.iArrow],this.nArrowY[this.iArrow];
      this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;
    }
//all the following removes an arrow if it went off screen.
    if (this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]>=64||
        this.nArrowX[this.iArrow]<=0||
        this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]>=64||
        this.nArrowY[this.iArrow]<=0){
      this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]=this.cArrowLife*20;
    }
    if (this.iArrowTime[this.iArrow]>=(this.cArrowLife*20)){  //if the arrow has been on screen to long, this'll remove it
      hideimg this.iArrow;
//this resets all the variables
      for (b=this.iArrow;b<=this.iArrowOut&&b<20;b++) {
        this.nArrowX[b]=this.nArrowX[b+1];
        this.nArrowY[b]=this.nArrowY[b+1];
        this.iArrowDir[b]=this.iArrowDir[b+1];
        this.iArrowPause[b]=this.iArrowPause[b+1];
        this.iArrowTime[b]=this.iArrowTime[b+1]-1;
      }
//continued...
      this.nArrowX[this.iArrowOut]=-1;
      this.nArrowY[this.iArrowOut]=-1;
      this.iArrowDir[this.iArrowOut]=-1;
      this.iArrowTime[this.iArrowOut]=-1;
      this.iArrowPause[this.iArrowOut]=-1;
      this.iArrowOut--;
      hideimg this.iArrowOut;
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
//what to do if the weapon isn't loaded, and "s" was pushed
if (firedwithS&&strtofloat(#s(this.iLoaded))==0&&playerdarts>0){
  setbow blankimage.png;  //sets the bow properly
  playerdarts--;  //subtracts 1 dart from the player
  freezeplayer .5;  //freezes the player to "load" the bow
  playersprite=33;  //bow sprite
  this.BowOut=1;  //says the player's bow image is visible
  if (playerdir==0){  //what to do if the player faces up
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx-.3,playery-1.2;  //bow sprites
    changeimgpart 62,0,0,32,32;  //bow image part
  }
//below is the same as above but for the other 3 directions
  if (playerdir==1){
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx-1,playery;
    changeimgpart 62,32,0,32,32;
  }
  if (playerdir==2){
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx-.3,playery+.5;
    changeimgpart 62,64,0,32,32;
  }
  if (playerdir==3){
    showimg 62,crossbow32x32arrows8x30.png,playerx+2,playery;
    changeimgpart 62,96,0,32,32;
  }
  this.iLoading=1;  //says the player is loading the bow
  timeout=.05;
  setstring this.iLoaded,1;  //tells the npc the bow is now loaded
}

NPCEND

NPC - 42 19
// Graal2002 NPC by Stefan Knorr
if (created) {
  // Initialize the attributes
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head17.png;
  setcharprop #C0,red;
  setcharprop #C1,black;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,brown;
  setcharprop #n,Theif;
  setcharprop #2,no-shield.png;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 3;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  hearts = 3;
sprite = 14;
}
if (playerenters || wasthrown) {
  // Initialize the this. variables
  timeout = 0.05;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 5; // RESPAWN
    this.runcounter = 0;
    timeout = 5;
  } else {
    this.mode = 0;
    setcharani idle,;
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
  }
}

// Hurting stuff
if (washit && this.mode!=1 && hearts>0) {
  dx = x-playerx;
  dy = y-playery;
  len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
  hurtdx = dx/len;
  hurtdy = dy/len;
  setcharani hurt,;
  hideimg 1;
  hearts -= playerswordpower/2;
}
if ((exploded || waspelt || wasshot) &&
    this.mode!=1 && hearts>0 && isleader) {
  hurtdx = -vecx(dir)*0.2;
  hurtdy = -vecy(dir)*0.2;
  setcharani hurt,;
  if (peltwithsign || peltwithvase || peltwithstone || peltwithnpc) hearts -= 1;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) hearts -= 1.5;
  else hearts -= 0.5;
}
if ((hurtdx!=0 || hurtdy!=0) && isleader && this.mode!=4) {
  this.hurtdx = hurtdx;
  this.hurtdy = hurtdy;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 4; // DYING
    message;
    setcharani dead,;
    timeout = 1.2;
  } else {
    this.mode = 1; // HURTED
    this.runcounter = 20;
    setcharani hurt,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
if (timeout && this.mode==1) { // HURTED
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>10) {
    testx = x + 1.5 + this.hurtdx*2;
    testy = y + 2 + this.hurtdy*2;
    if (!onwall(testx,testy)) {
      x += this.hurtdx;
      y += this.hurtdy;
    }
  }
  if (this.runcounter<=0) {
    if (swordpower>0) this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    else this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.runcounter = 100;
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==4) { // DYING
  i = random(0,100);
  if (i<10) lay greenrupee;
  else if (i<15) lay bluerupee;
  else if (i<30) lay heart;
}
if(playerlaysitem){
take goldrupee; take greenrupee; take bluerupee; take redrupee;

tosafe=rupees;

}

NPCEND

//"this.shootdist" is how far away the baddy must be before it tries to use the bow
//"this.attackdist" is how close it must be before it'll swing its sword (to make it easier to hit with the sword, I'd suggest lowering this)
//"this.throwdist" is how clost it must be before it'll throw what its carrying (if carrying)
//"this.boomdist" is how far the boomerang will travel
//"this.usesdarts" enables the use of the darts in the baddy
//(if equal to 1, each time the baddy shoots, 1 dart will be subtracted from its total, when the total is 0, itll use the boomerang)
//"this.speed" is how fast the baddy moves
//"this.magspeed" is how fast magic moves
//"this.wepspeed" is how fast the boomerang moves
//"this.castdelay" is the amount of time the baddy speaks before deciding to cast magic (every 2.5 seconds the baddy chats)
//
//All distance related variables are measured in Graal-Tiles (1 tile is 16x16 pixels, fyi)
//
timereverywhere;
function DefineChar(){
  setcharprop #n,Ninji Power God;
  setcharprop #1,darkflame-sword.png;
  setcharprop #2,staff-shield.png;
  setcharprop #3,head.png;
  setcharprop #7,wbow2.gif;
  setcharprop #C0,black;
  setcharprop #C1,darkred;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,black;
  setcharprop #C4,black;

  hearts=65;
  shieldpower=10;
  swordpower=15;
  ap=100;
  this.arrowpow=8;
  this.boompow=8;
  rupees=2896;
  darts=int(random(20,60));
  bombs=int(random(0,100));
  this.shootdist=20;
  this.attackdist=8;
  this.throwdist=20;
  this.boomdist=30;
  this.usesdarts=130;
  this.speed=.9;
  this.wepspeed=2.15;
  this.magspeed=.9;
  this.castdelay=5;
}
function Aim(){
  this.msgc++;
  if (this.msgc>=50){
    Chat();
    this.msgc=0;
  }
  if (this.distx<this.disty){
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x+3+this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x+=this.speed;
      dir=3;
    }
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x-this.speed,y+1.5)){
      x-=this.speed;
      dir=1;
    }
  }else{
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.speed)){
      y+=this.speed;
      dir=2;
    }
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.speed)){
      y-=this.speed;
      dir=0;
    }
  }
  ShootCheck();
}
function ArrowDodge(){
  if (arrowscount<1)return;
  else{
    for (i=0;i<arrowscount;i++){
      if (dir=(arrows[i].dir+2)%4&&
         ((dir==0&&arrows[i].y<y&&(y+1.5)-arrows[i].y<=6)||
          (dir==1&&arrows[i].x<x&&(x+1.5)-arrows[i].x<=6)||
          (dir==2&&arrows[i].y>y&&arrows[i].y-(y+1.5)<=6)||
          (dir==3&&arrows[i].x>x&&arrows[i].x-(x+1.5)<=6))){
        Teleport();
        Clothing();
      }
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function AttackCheck(){
  if (this.carry==1&&this.dist<=this.throwdist)Throw();
  else if (this.dist<=this.attackdist){
    message Ninjis hate weaklings;
    this.swing=1;
    sprite=9;
    sleep .05;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function BombCheck(){
  this.wait=0;
  if (bombscount>0){
    this.curdist=65;
    for (i=0;i<bombscount;i++){
      ConvertB();
      GetDist();
      if (this.dist<this.curdist){
        this.curdist=this.dist;
        this.bindex=i;
      }
    }
    if (this.dist<this.shootdist){
      this.oldbcount=bombscount;
      SmartBomb();
      message;
      this.c=0;
    }else return;
  }else return;
}
function Boomerang(){
  this.boom=1;
  message Take this!;
  if (dir==0||dir==2)sprite=13;
  else sprite=6;
  BoomImg();
  sleep .2;
  GetBoomDist();
  ConvertPB();
  FlyCheck();
  this.flycount=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function BoomImg(){
  if (dir==0){
    this.flyx=x-.7;
    this.flyy=y+1.4;
  }else if (dir==1){
    this.flyx=x+1.9;
    this.flyy=y+1.5;
  }else if (dir==2){
    this.flyx=x+2.3;
    this.flyy=y+.7;
  }else if (dir==3){
    this.flyx=x-.2;
    this.flyy=y+1.5;
  }
  showimg 1,wboom1.gif,this.flyx,this.flyy;
}
function BoomReturn(){
  ConvertFly();
  GetDist();
  ConvertNPCB();
  FlyCheck();
  this.flyx+=this.flyaddx;
  this.flyy+=this.flyaddy;
  showimg 1,wboom.gif,this.flyx,this.flyy;
  if(testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy)>-1)hitplayer testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy),this.boompow,this.flyx,this.flyy;
  timeout=.05;
}
function BounceBack(){
  Throw();
  this.hit=1;
  while(this.hit==1&&i<7){
    MoveBoom();
    i++;
    if (x>playerx&&!onwall(x+2.5,y+1.5)) x+=.5;
    if (x<playerx&&!onwall(x-.5,y+1.5)) x-=.5;
    if (y>playery&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+2.5)) y+=.5;
    if (y<playery&&!onwall(x-1.5,y-.5)) y-=.5;
    sleep .05;
  }
  this.hit=0;
  i=0;
  this.swing=0;
  this.cast=0;
  this.magic=0;
  this.shield=0;
  this.checkbomb=0;
  if (hearts>0)CounterMagic();
  timeout=.05;
}
function Catch(){
  message You throw like a newbie!;
  this.msgc=0;
  this.carry=1;
  sprite=24;
  if (peltwithbush) carryobject bush;
  else if (peltwithsign) carryobject sign;
  else if (peltwithvase) carryobject vase;
  else if (peltwithstone) carryobject stone;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) carryobject blackstone;
  else if (!peltwithnpc){
    i=bombscount-1;
    if (bombs[i].power==1) carryobject bomb;
    else if (bombs[i].power==2) carryobject superbomb;
    else if (bombs[i].power==3) carryobject joltbomb;
    removebomb i;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function Chat(){
  if (this.magdelay<this.castdelay){
    this.message=int(random(0,5));
    if (this.message==0)message Runaway!;
    else if (this.message==1) message Come here and fight like a ninji!;
    else if (this.message==2) message You're no chance against me...;
    else if (this.message==3) message Even a newbie ninji can beat you!;
    else if (this.message==4) message Tsk, tsk, tsk...;
    this.magdelay++;
  }else{
    this.magdelay=0;
    CounterMagic();
  }
}
function Clothing(){
  setcharprop #C0,black;
  setcharprop #C1,darkred;
  setcharprop #C2,black;
  setcharprop #C3,black;
  setcharprop #C4,black;}
function ConvertA(){
  this.tox=arrows[i].x;
  this.toy=arrows[i].y;
}
function ConvertB(){
  this.tox=bombs[i].x;
  this.toy=bombs[i].y;
}
function ConvertBi(){
  this.tox=bombs[this.bindex].x;
  this.toy=bombs[this.bindex].y;
}
function ConvertFly(){
  this.toy=this.flyy;
  this.tox=this.flyx;
}
function ConvertNPCB(){
  this.toflyx=x;
  this.toflyy=y;
}
function ConvertP(){
  this.tox=playerx;
  this.toy=playery;
}
function ConvertPB(){
  this.toflyx=playerx;
  this.toflyy=playery;
}
function CounterMagic(){
  Clothing();
  Throw();
  sprite=24;
  dir=2;
  message Ninji Magic Shield;
  this.shield=1;
  this.c=0;
  this.radius=4;
  this.angle=3.14/2;
  while (this.c<100){
    if (this.c==50){
      if (hearts<=2)this.magic=1;
      else this.magic=int(random(1,5));
    }
    if (this.magic!=0){
      if (this.magic==1)Drain();
      if (this.magic==2)Freeze();
      if (this.magic==3)Flame();
      if (this.magic==4)Jolt();
    }
    MoveBoom();
    MagicShield();
    if (this.magic!=3)sleep .05;
    else sleep .1;
    this.c++;
  }
  if (this.c>=100){
    this.c=0;
    hideimg 2;
    hideimg 3;
    hideimg 4;
    sprite=0;
    this.shield=0;
    this.magic=0;
    this.cast=0;
    this.p=0;
    this.magdelay=0;
    Chat();
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function Direction(){
  if (this.distx<=this.disty){
    if (this.toy<y)dir=0;
    if (this.toy>y)dir=2;
  }else{
    if (this.tox<x)dir=1;
    if (this.tox>x)dir=3;
  }
}
function Drain(){
  ConvertP();
  GetMagDist();
  Direction();
  message Life Drain!;
  if (this.cast!=1){
    if (dir==0||dir==2)sprite=13;
    else sprite=6;
    MagImg();
    showimg 3,drainm.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    sleep .2;
    this.cast=1;
  }else if (this.cast==1){
    sprite=24;
    ConvertP();
    GetMagDist();
    MagMoveCheck();
    showimg 4,drainf.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    MagMove();
    showimg 3,drainm.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    for (i=0;i<playerscount;i++){
      if (players[i].id>-1&&abs(players[i].x-this.magx)<=2&&abs(players[i].y-this.magy)<=2){
        hitplayer i,swordpower*2,this.magx,this.magy;
        hearts+=swordpower;
        hideimg 3;
        hideimg 4;
        this.cast=0;
        this.c=100;
      }
    }
  }
}
function DropInv(){
  while(rupees>=100){
    lay goldrupee;
    rupees-=100;
  }
  while(rupees>=30){
    lay redrupee;
    rupees-=30;
  }
  while(rupees>=5){
    lay bluerupee;
    rupees-=5;
  }
  while(rupees>0){
    lay greenrupee;
    rupees-=1;
  }
  while(darts>0){
    lay darts;
    darts-=5;
  }
  while(bombs>0){
    lay bombs;
    bombs-=5;
  }
}

function ExploMove(){
  sprite=11;
  if (dir==0){
    this.e1y-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2x+=.4;
    this.e2y-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3x-=.4;
    this.e3y-=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (dir==1){
    this.e1x-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2y+=.4;
    this.e2x-=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3y-=.4;
    this.e3x-=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (dir==2){
    this.e1y+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2x-=.4;
    this.e2y+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3x+=.4;
    this.e3y+=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (dir==3){
    this.e1x+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e2y-=.4;
    this.e2x+=this.magspeed*2;
    this.e3y+=.4;
    this.e3x+=this.magspeed*2;
  }
  if (this.e1x<=0||this.e1x>=64||this.e1y<=0||this.e1y>=64){
    this.cast=0;
    this.c=100;
  }
  putexplosion 1,this.e1x,this.e1y;
  putexplosion 1,this.e2x,this.e2y;
  putexplosion 1,this.e3x,this.e3y;
}
function Flame(){
  message Ninji Fire Sword Attack!;
  if (this.p!=1){
    ConvertP();
    GetDist();
    Direction();
    if (dir==0){
      this.e1x=x+1.5;
      this.e1y=y-1;
      this.e2x=x+1.5;
      this.e2y=y-1;
      this.e3x=x+1.5;
      this.e3y=y-1;
    }
    if (dir==1){
      this.e1x=x-1;
      this.e1y=y+1.5;
      this.e2x=x-1;
      this.e2y=y+1.5;
      this.e3x=x-1;
      this.e3y=y+1.5;
    }
    if (dir==2){
      this.e1x=x+1.5;
      this.e1y=y+4;
      this.e2x=x+1.5;
      this.e2y=y+4;
      this.e3x=x+1.5;
      this.e3y=y+4;
    }
    if (dir==3){
      this.e1x=x+4;
      this.e1y=y+1.5;
      this.e2x=x+4;
      this.e2y=y+1.5;
      this.e3x=x+4;
      this.e3y=y+1.5;
    }
    this.p=1;
  }
  ExploMove();
}
function FlyCheck(){
  if (this.distx==0){
    if (this.flyy>this.toflyy)this.flyaddy=-this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddy=this.wepspeed;
  }else if (this.disty==0){
    if (this.flyx>this.toflyx)this.flyaddx=-this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddx=this.wepspeed;
  }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    if (this.flyx>this.toflyx)this.flyaddx=-this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddx=this.wepspeed;
    if (this.flyy>this.toflyy)this.flyaddy=-this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.flyaddy=this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.distx<this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    if (this.flyy<this.toflyy)this.flyaddy=this.wepspeed;
    else this.flyaddy=-this.wepspeed;
    if (this.flyx<this.toflyx)this.flyaddx=this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.flyaddx=-this.wepspeed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Freeze(){
  ConvertP();
  GetDist();
  Direction();
  message Ninji Freeze Attack!;
  if (this.cast!=1){
    if (dir==0||dir==2)sprite=13;
    else sprite=6;
    MagImg();
    showimg 3,freezem.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    sleep .2;
    this.cast=1;
  }else if (this.cast==1){
    ConvertP();
    GetMagDist();
    MagMoveCheck();
    showimg 4,freezef.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    MagMove();
    showimg 3,freezem.png,this.magx,this.magy;
    for (i=0;i<playerscount;i++){
      if (players[i].id>-1&&abs(players[i].x-this.magx)<=2&&abs(players[i].y-this.magy)<=2){
        this.tox=x;
        this.toy=y;
        PreOmni();
        PreTel();
        sleep .25;
        x=playerx+3;
        y=playery;
        dir=1;
        sleep .25;
        Clothing();
        message Omni-Slash!;
        OmniSlash();
        x=playerx;
        y=playery-3;
        OmniSlash();
        playerhearts--;
        x=playerx-3;
        y=playery;
        OmniSlash();
        playerhearts--;
        x=playerx;
        y=playery+3;
        OmniSlash();
        playerhearts--;
        PreTel();
        sleep .25;
        x=this.tox;
        y=this.toy;
        sleep .25;
        Clothing();
        Chat();
        this.cast=0;
        this.c=100;
      }
    }
  }
}
function GetBoomDist(){
  this.distx=abs(this.tox-this.flyx);
  this.disty=abs(this.toy-this.flyy);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function GetDist(){
  this.distx=abs(this.tox-x);
  this.disty=abs(this.toy-y);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function GetMagDist(){
  this.distx=abs(this.tox-this.magx);
  this.disty=abs(this.toy-this.magy);
  this.dist=((this.distx*this.distx)+(this.disty*this.disty))^.5;
}
function ItemDrop(){
  i = random(0,100);
  if (i<10) lay greenrupee;
  else if (i<15) lay bluerupee;
  else if (i<30) lay heart;
}
function Jolt(){
  message Electric Spiral!;
  if (this.p!=1){
    this.angle=3.14/2;
    this.radius=4;
    this.p=1;
  }else{
    JoltMove();
  }
}
function JoltMove(){
  this.e1x=x+1.5+cos(this.angle)*this.radius;
  this.e1y=y+1.5+sin(this.angle)*this.radius;
  this.angle+=.314;
  this.radius+=.2;
  putexplosion2 3,1,this.e1x,this.e1y;
}
function MagicShield(){
  this.imgx=x-1.5;
  this.imgy=y-1.5;
  showimg 2,magishield.png,this.imgx,this.imgy;
  changeimgvis 2,0;
  for (i=0;i<exploscount;i++){
    if (explos[i].x>this.imgx-1&&explos[i].x<this.imgx+6&&explos[i].y>this.imgy-1&&explos[i].y<this.imgy+6)removeexplo i;
  }
  for (i=0;i<bombscount;i++){
    if (bombs[i].x>this.imgx-1&&bombs[i].x<this.imgx+6&&bombs[i].y>this.imgy-1&&bombs[i].y<this.imgy+6)explodebomb i;
  }
  for (i=0;i<arrowscount;i++){
    if (arrows[i].x>this.imgx-1&&arrows[i].x<this.imgx+6&&arrows[i].y>this.imgy-1&&arrows[i].y<this.imgy+6){
      if (arrows[i].type==0||arrows[i].type==1)removearrow i;
      else reflectarrow i;
    }
  }
}
function MagImg(){
  if (dir==0){
    this.magx=x-.7;
    this.magy=y+1.4;
  }
  if (dir==1){
    this.magx=x+1.9;
    this.magy=y+1.5;
  }
  if (dir==2){
    this.magx=x+2.3;
    this.magy=y+.7;
  }
  if (dir==3){
    this.magx=x-.2;
    this.magy=y+1.5;
  }
}
function MagMove(){
    this.magx+=this.addx;
    this.magy+=this.addy;
}
function MagMoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx==0){
    if (this.magy>this.toy)this.addy=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addy=this.magspeed;
  }else if (this.disty==0){
    if (this.magx>this.tox)this.addx=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addx=this.magspeed;
  }else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    if (this.magx>this.tox)this.addx=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addx=this.magspeed;
    if (this.magy>this.toy)this.addy=-this.magspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.addy=this.magspeed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.distx<this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    if (this.magy>this.toy)this.addy=-this.magspeed;
    else this.addy=this.magspeed;
    if (this.magx>this.tox)this.addx=-this.magspeed*this.ratio;
    else this.addx=this.magspeed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function MoveBoom(){
  if (this.boom==1){
    if (this.flycount<this.boomdist){
      this.flycount++;
      this.flyx+=this.flyaddx;
      this.flyy+=this.flyaddy;
      showimg 1,wboom.gif,this.flyx,this.flyy;
      if(testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy)>-1)hitplayer testplayer(this.flyx,this.flyy),this.boompow,this.flyx,this.flyy;
    }else{
      BoomReturn();
      if (this.dist<=2){
        hideimg 1;
        this.flycounter=0;
        this.boom=0;
      }
    }
  }
}
function MoveCheck(){
  if (this.distx<=.5)this.addy=this.speed;
  else if (this.disty<=.5)this.addx=this.speed;
  else if (this.distx>this.disty){
    this.ratio=this.disty/this.distx;
    this.addx=this.speed;
    this.addy=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }else if (this.disty>this.distx){
    this.ratio=this.distx/this.disty;
    this.addy=this.speed;
    this.addx=this.speed*this.ratio;
  }
}
function Movement(){
  if (y<this.toy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y+3+this.addy)) y+=this.addy;
  if (y>this.toy&&!onwall(x+1.5,y-this.addy)) y-=this.addy;
  if (x<this.tox&&!onwall(x+3+this.addx,y+1.5)) x+=this.addx;
  if (x>this.tox&&!onwall(x-this.addx,y+1.5)) x-=this.addx;
}
function OmniSlash(){
  sprite=9;
  while (sprite<13){
    playerx=this.px;
    playery=this.py;
    sprite++;
    MoveBoom();
    sleep .05;
  }
  if (dir<3)dir++;
  else dir=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function PreOmni(){
  this.tox=x;
  this.toy=y;
  showimg 3,wiceblock.gif,playerx,playery;
  this.px=playerx;
  this.py=playery;
  freezeplayer 2;
  hideimg 4;
  hideimg 2;
  timeout=.05;
}
function PreTel(){
  message Too slow!;
  setcharprop #C0,transparent;
  setcharprop #C1,transparent;
  setcharprop #C2,transparent;
  setcharprop #C3,transparent;
  setcharprop #C4,transparent;
  sprite=24;
}
function ShootBow(){
  sprite=33;
  if (this.arrowpow==1)shootarrow dir;
  if (this.arrowpow==2)shootfireball dir;
  if (this.arrowpow==3)shootfireblast dir;
  if (this.arrowpow==4)shootnuke dir;
  sleep .1;
  sprite=0;
  timeout=.05;
}
function ShootCheck(){
  if (this.usesdarts==1&&darts<1&&this.boom!=1){
    ConvertP();
    GetDist();
    if (abs(this.distx-this.disty)<=4){
      Direction();
      Boomerang();
    }
  }
  if((x-playerx<1&&playerx-x<1)||(y-playery<1&&playery-y<1)){
    if ((this.usesdarts==1&&darts>0)||this.usesdarts!=1){
      ConvertP();
      GetDist();
      Direction();
      message Take this!;
      sprite=33;
      while (this.scc<.4){
        sleep .05;
        ArrowDodge();
        this.scc+=.05;
      }
      if (this.scc>=.4){
        if (this.usesdarts==1)darts--;
        ShootBow();
        this.scc=0;
      }
    }else if (this.usesdarts==1&&darts<=0&&this.boom!=1){
      ConvertP();
      GetDist();
      Direction();
      Boomerang();
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SmartBomb(){
  if (bombs[this.bindex].time<2||this.carry==1){
    if (bombs[this.bindex].power==1||bombs[this.bindex].power==3){
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x<x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)+3;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x>x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)-3;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y<y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)+4;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y>y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)-4;
    }else if (bombs[this.bindex].power==2){
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x<x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)+7;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].x>x)this.tox=(bombs[this.bindex].x+1)-7;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y<y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)+8;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].y>y)this.toy=(bombs[this.bindex].y+1)-8;
    }
    GetDist();
    MoveCheck();
    while (this.dist>2&&bombs[this.bindex].time>0&&bombscount>0&&this.wait!=1){
      if (this.oldbcount!=bombscount){
        ConvertP();
        BombCheck();
      }
      SpriteAssign();
      Direction();
      Movement();
      if (this.hit!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
        if (washit){
          hurtdx=x;
          hurtdy=y;
          hearts-=playerswordpower;
        }
        if (exploded)hearts--;
        if (waspelt)hearts--;
        if (wasshot)hearts--;
        Throw();
        sprite=39;
        BounceBack();
        timeout=.05;
      }
      MoveBoom();
      ArrowDodge();
      Clothing();
      sleep .05;
      GetDist();
    }
    while (bombs[this.bindex].time>.1&&bombscount>0){
      this.wait=1;
      Wait();
      sleep .05;
      if (this.oldbcount!=bombscount) BombCheck();
    }
    while(bombs[this.bindex].time<=.1&&this.c<22){
      this.c++;
      Wait();
      sleep .05;
    }
  }else if (this.carry==0||bombs[this.bindex].time>=2){
    MoveCheck();
    while (abs(bombs[this.bindex].x-x)>2&&abs(bombs[this.bindex].y-y)>2){
      if (bombscount==0) return;
      if (this.oldbcount!=bombscount) BombCheck();
      SpriteAssign();
      Direction();
      Movement();
      if (this.hit!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
        if (washit){
          hurtdx=x;
          hurtdy=y;
          hearts-=playerswordpower;
        }
        if (exploded)hearts--;
        if (waspelt)hearts--;
        if (wasshot)hearts--;
        Throw();
        sprite=39;
        BounceBack();
        timeout=.05;
      }
      MoveBoom();
      ArrowDodge();
      Clothing();
      sleep .05;
      ConvertBi();
      GetDist();
    }
    if (abs(bombs[this.bindex].x-x)<=2&&abs(bombs[this.bindex].y-y)<=2){
      message Impossible!!!;
      sprite=23;
      sleep .1;
      sprite=24;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].power==1) carryobject bomb;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].power==2) carryobject superbomb;
      if (bombs[this.bindex].power==3) carryobject joltbomb;
      this.carry=1;
      removebomb this.bindex;
    }
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpinMove(){
  message Impossible!!!;
  sprite=0;
  while(d<=8){
    dir=(dir+3)%4;
    d++;
    sleep .1;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SpriteAssign(){
  if (this.carry!=1) sprite=(sprite%8)+1;
  else if (this.carry==1){
    if (sprite<32)sprite++;
    else sprite=25;
  }
  timeout=.05;
}
function SwordAttack(){
  if (sprite<13)sprite++;
  else{
    sprite=0;
    this.dist+=1;
    this.swing=0;
    Chat();
  }
}
function Teleport(){
  this.telx=x;
  this.tely=y;
  PreTel();
  sleep .1;
  if (dir==0||dir==2){
    if (playerx>x)x-=3;
    else x+=3;
  }
  if (dir==1||dir==3){
    if (playery>y)y-=4;
    else y+=4;
  }
  while (this.c<.3){
    sleep .05;
    this.c+=.05;
    MoveBoom();
  }
  this.c=0;
  this.swing=0;
  this.scc=0;
  this.checkbomb=0;
  x=this.telx;
  y=this.tely;
  if (this.carry!=1)sprite=0;
  else if (this.carry==1)sprite=24;
  timeout=.05;
}
function Throw(){
  throwcarry;
  this.carry=0;
}
function Wait(){
  if (this.shield==1){
    this.wait=0;
    timeout=.05;
  }else{
    message .........;
    if (this.carry!=1){
      sprite=0;
      ShootCheck();
    }else sprite=24;
    if (this.hit!=1&&hearts>0&&(washit||exploded||(waspelt&&this.carry==1)||wasshot)){
      if (washit){
        hurtdx=x;
        hurtdy=y;
        hearts-=playerswordpower;
      }
      if (exploded)hearts--;
      if (waspelt)hearts--;
      if (wasshot)hearts--;
      Throw();
      sprite=39;
      BounceBack();
      timeout=.05;
    }
    ArrowDodge();
    Clothing();
    ConvertP();
    GetDist();
    Direction();
    AttackCheck();
    MoveBoom();
  }
}
